ex_AOAQ46.name: 45 Degree Bicycle Twist Knee to Elbow
instructions: Align yourself to 45 degrees to the floor by fixing your left foot into the footrest and supporting your thigh against the padded platform.
Place your left hand behind your head and your right hand on your waist.
Open your upper leg slightly and bend your knee while bringing your opposite elbow towards it.
Return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Keep your hips pressed on the hyperextension bench to engage your core muscles more effectively and protect your spine.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hand; use your core to lift and twist, keeping your neck in a neutral position.
Perform the exercise slowly and deliberately to maximize muscle engagement and reduce the risk of strain.
ex_AOAQ46.description: 45 Degree Bicycle Twist Knee to Elbow is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_SNSYCR.name: 45 Degree Side Bend
instructions: Place your feet one after the other onto the footrests and support your thigh against the platform.
Place your hands behind your head and assume an upright position with a straight back.
Crunch your torso toward the platform and then to the other side.
Repeat while keeping yourself stable.
tips: Maintain a steady and controlled pace to ensure proper form and prevent strain.
Focus on using your oblique muscles to lift your upper body, avoiding any jerking or sudden movements.
Keep your neck in a neutral position to avoid straining it during the exercise.
ex_SNSYCR.description: 45 Degree Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

ex_TF7UME.name: 45 Degree Twisting Hyperextension
instructions: Fix your feet to the footrests and press your thighs against the padded platform.
Place your hands behind your head and lean forward.
Raise yourself by leaning backward and twisting your torso to a side.
Hold for a while, return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Perform the twisting motion smoothly and avoid jerking to prevent strain on your back.
Engage your core muscles throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your spine.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift and twist, and inhaling as you lower back down.
ex_TF7UME.description: 45 Degree Twisting Hyperextension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Glutes.

ex_YHK2UV.name: 90 Degree Heel Touch
instructions: Lie down on your back with your hips and knees bent to 90 degrees and your arms extended overhead.
Raise your upper back and bring your arms forward to touch your heels.
Hold for a while, return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed and avoid straining it by using your core muscles to lift your shoulders.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed into the mat to engage your core effectively and protect your spine.
Perform the exercise with controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and reduce the risk of injury.
ex_YHK2UV.description: 90 Degree Heel Touch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_EHLMJ7.name: Ab Wheel All the Way Out
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward, extending your body into a straight line while keeping your core engaged and your hips slightly extended backward.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position, using your core muscles to control the movement and maintain stability.
Repeat the movement, extending fully and returning to the starting position each time.
tips: Keep your core muscles engaged throughout the exercise to protect your lower back and maintain stability.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding using momentum to maximize muscle engagement.
Ensure your hips are slightly extended backward when rolling out to maintain proper form and prevent lower back strain.
ex_EHLMJ7.description: Ab Wheel All the Way Out is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_OS6EDH.name: Ab Wheel Halfway Out
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward, extending your body halfway while keeping your core engaged and your hips slightly extended backward.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position, using your core muscles to control the movement and maintain stability.
Repeat the movement, extending halfway and returning to the starting position each time.
tips: Keep your core muscles engaged throughout the exercise to protect your lower back and maintain stability.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding using momentum to maximize muscle engagement.
Ensure your hips are slightly extended backward when rolling out to maintain proper form and prevent lower back strain.
ex_OS6EDH.description: Ab Wheel Halfway Out is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_FM2RGC.name: Ab Wheel Left Out
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward and to the left, extending your body into a partial straight line while keeping your core engaged and your hips slightly extended backward.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position, using your core muscles to control the movement and maintain stability.
Repeat the movement, rolling out to the left and returning to the starting position each time.
tips: Avoid overextending and roll out only as far as you can maintain control. Overextending can place unnecessary strain on your lower back and shoulders.
Breathe steadily. Inhale as you roll out and exhale as you roll back in. Proper breathing helps maintain core engagement and stability.
Ensure your hips are slightly extended backward when rolling out to maintain proper form and prevent lower back strain.
ex_FM2RGC.description: Ab Wheel Left Out is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_VLFGGQ.name: Ab Wheel Pulses
instructions: Start by lying on the floor with your arms extended overhead, holding the ab wheel with both hands.
Engage your core by lifting your upper body off the floor slightly, performing a small crunch while keeping your arms extended and the ab wheel overhead.
Perform small pulsing crunches, lifting and lowering your upper body slightly while maintaining tension in your core.
Continue the pulsing movement for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your arms extended and the ab wheel steady.
tips: Keep your movements small and controlled to maintain tension on your core muscles.
Focus on maintaining a neutral spine and avoiding any strain on your neck by using your core to lift your upper body.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift into the crunch and inhaling as you lower back down.
ex_VLFGGQ.description: Ab Wheel Pulses is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_WWPC3W.name: Ab Wheel Right Out
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward and to the right, extending your body into a partial straight line while keeping your core engaged and your hips slightly extended backward.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position, using your core muscles to control the movement and maintain stability.
Repeat the movement, rolling out to the right and returning to the starting position each time.
tips: Avoid overextending and roll out only as far as you can maintain control. Overextending can place unnecessary strain on your lower back and shoulders.
Breathe steadily. Inhale as you roll out and exhale as you roll back in. Proper breathing helps maintain core engagement and stability.
Ensure your hips are slightly extended backward when rolling out to maintain proper form and prevent lower back strain.
ex_WWPC3W.description: Ab Wheel Right Out is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_LZS26F.name: Ab Wheel Take It or Leave It
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs bent at 90 degrees and your feet off the floor, forming a tabletop position. Hold the AB wheel overhead with both hands, keeping your arms straight.
Engage your core and lift your chest towards your knees to perform a crunch, bringing the AB wheel towards your shins.
Place the AB wheel gently on your shins and lower your upper body back to the floor, keeping your legs in the tabletop position.
Perform another crunch, reaching up to grab the AB wheel from your shins, and then lower your upper body back to the floor. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your legs remain bent at 90 degrees and your shins stay parallel to the floor throughout the exercise.
Avoid using momentum to lift your upper body; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
ex_LZS26F.description: Ab Wheel Take It or Leave It is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_C5OZ5Y.name: Abdominal Crunches Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and resistance to your desired settings on the abdominal crunch machine. Sit on the seat and position your feet securely on the footrests.
Grab the handles, ensuring your elbows are pointed forward.
Engage your core muscles and crunch your abdominals by pulling your upper body forward and curling your chest towards your knees.
Hold the crunch for a second, then slowly return to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you crunch forward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Avoid using momentum; focus on engaging your abdominal muscles throughout the exercise.
Ensure your lower back remains in contact with the backrest of the machine.
ex_C5OZ5Y.description: Abdominal Crunches Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_FLBMPI.name: Abdominal Crunches With Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent and feet placed on the floor.
Inhale and try reaching forward with straight arms while lifting your upper back off the floor. 3. Hold the end position for few seconds and slowly return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pulling on it with your hands to prevent strain.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement to maximize effectiveness.
Hold the crunch position for a count of two to five seconds to increase muscle activation and endurance.
ex_FLBMPI.description: Abdominal Crunches With Hold is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_AH72ZW.name: Abdominal Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent, feet placed on the floor and arms raised to the shoulder height.
Squeeze your abdominals and lift your upper back off the floor, reaching forward with your arms
Hold for few seconds and slowly return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pulling on it with your hands to prevent strain.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement to maximize effectiveness.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift into the crunch and inhaling as you lower back down.
ex_AH72ZW.description: Abdominal Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_QBLYEP.name: Abs Snails
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended, hands placed behind your hips.
Lean your torso backward while squeezing your glutes, extending your hips upward.
Contract your abdominal muscles to pull your torso back upright, returning your hips to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, while moving your body forward in the opposite direction.
tips: Move slowly and avoid using momentum to rock your body.
Maintain a straight back and avoid excessive arching or overextending.
Push your hands into the ground for stability
Exhale as you lift your hips, and pull your hips through your arms. Inhale at the starting position.
ex_QBLYEP.description: Abs Snails is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Abdominals, Shoulders.

ex_YPNZO6.name: Air Bike Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lift your shoulders off the floor, engaging your core.
Bring your right elbow towards your left knee while extending your right leg lightly.
Switch sides, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee while extending your left leg lightly. Continue alternating sides in a pedaling motion.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding the use of momentum to maximize effectiveness.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you twist and bring your elbow to your knee, and inhaling as you switch sides.
ex_YPNZO6.description: Air Bike Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_YY5T6Q.name: Air Twisting Crunch
instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and heels on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Raise your chest and twist your torso to one side while bringing the opposite knee close.
Return to the initial position and repeat by twisting towards the other side.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding the use of momentum to maximize effectiveness.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you twist and bring your elbow to your knee, and inhaling as you switch sides.
ex_YY5T6Q.description: Air Twisting Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_RVVVC2.name: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Hold
instructions: Start in a plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously, extending them straight out while maintaining balance. Hold this position for a brief period of 1-2 seconds.
Lower your right arm and left leg back to the plank position.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously, extending them straight out and holding for a brief period of 1-2 seconds before returning to the plank position.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your arm and leg and inhaling as you hold the position.
ex_RVVVC2.description: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Hold is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Hip Flexors.

ex_Z6LQA3.name: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Rest Pause
instructions: Start in a plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously, extending them straight out while maintaining balance. Then lower back to the plank position and pause for a few seconds.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously, extending them straight out and return to the plank position and pause for a few seconds.
Continue alternating sides, lifting opposite arms and legs with a brief pause in the plank position.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your arm and leg and inhaling as you pause in the plank position.
ex_Z6LQA3.description: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Rest Pause is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Hip Flexors.

ex_SY64AW.name: Alternate Arm Leg Plank
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously, extending them straight out while maintaining balance. Hold briefly, then lower back to the plank position.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously, extending them straight out and holding briefly before returning to the plank position.
Continue alternating sides, lifting opposite arms and legs.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your arm and leg and inhaling as you lower them back to the plank position.
ex_SY64AW.description: Alternate Arm Leg Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Hip Flexors.

ex_PYHLC3.name: Alternate Heel Touches
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor, engaging your core.
Reach your right hand towards your right heel, then return to the center position.
Reach your left hand towards your left heel. Continue alternating sides in this manner.
tips: Keep your shoulders off the mat and your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize effectiveness.
Focus on using your oblique muscles to reach towards your heels rather than using your arms.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maintain proper form and maximize muscle engagement.
ex_PYHLC3.description: Alternate Heel Touches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_BSG4BB.name: Alternate Leg Pull
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight at 45 degrees off the floor and your arms extended overhead in line with your torso.
Lift your shoulders off the mat, engaging your core, and simultaneously bring your right knee towards your chest while swinging both arms in an arc motion until parallel to the floor.
Straighten your right leg, and lower your arms and shoulders back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, bringing it towards your chest between your straight arms. Continue alternating sides in this manner.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to avoid using momentum and ensure proper form.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you crunch and bring your leg towards your chest and inhaling as you lower back down.
ex_BSG4BB.description: Alternate Leg Pull is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Obliques.

ex_VKMVQB.name: Alternate Leg Raise From Reverse Plank Position
instructions: Lie down on your hips with your arms resting on the floor by your side and your legs extended forward.
Raise your upper back, bring your elbows under the shoulders, and bear weight on your forearms with your palms down.
Alternately raise and lower your legs to your maximum range while keeping them straight.
tips: Focus on maintaining a straight line with your body, avoiding any sagging or arching of the back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it back down.
ex_VKMVQB.description: Alternate Leg Raise From Reverse Plank Position is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

ex_HJHYHK.name: Alternate Leg Raise With Head Up
instructions: Lie down on your back with your arms resting on the floor by your side.
Raise your head and upper back off the floor, and lift your legs straight in the air, making a 90-degree angle with your torso.
Lower one of your legs and bring it back just before touching the floor.
Do the same with your other leg, and repeat.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it back down.
ex_HJHYHK.description: Alternate Leg Raise With Head Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_5W2HZ7.name: Alternate Leg Raise
instructions: Lie down on your back with your arms resting on the floor by your side.
Raise your legs straight in the air, making a 90-degree angle with your torso.
Lower one of your legs and bring it back just before touching the floor.
Do the same with your other leg, and repeat.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it back down.
ex_5W2HZ7.description: Alternate Leg Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

ex_GU7LBG.name: Alternate Lying Floor Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight and your arms resting by your sides.
Lift both legs, straight towards the ceiling until they go past your hips.
Lower your legs halfway down, then lift them back up towards the ceiling.
Lower your legs back down to the initial position. Repeat the movement.
tips: Focus on keeping your upper back pressed into the mat to avoid arching and straining your spine.
Use your breath to guide the movement: inhale as you lift your legs and exhale as you lower them.
Engage your thigh muscles to assist with the lift and ensure proper form.
ex_GU7LBG.description: Alternate Lying Floor Leg Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_PT5VNF.name: Alternate Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lie down on your back and fold your knees while keeping your feet on the floor.
Place your right hand behind your head and your left hand on the floor for support.
Raise and twist your chest to your left and bring your right elbow towards the left knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
tips: Focus on using your oblique muscles to twist your torso rather than pulling on your neck with your hands.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the mat to protect your spine.
ex_PT5VNF.description: Alternate Oblique Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals.

ex_Y2HEBN.name: Alternate Single Leg Raise Plank
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right leg off the floor, extending it straight back while maintaining the plank position. Hold briefly.
Lower your right leg back to the starting position.
Lift your left leg off the floor, extending it straight back. Hold briefly before lowering it back to the starting position. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Maintain a straight line from head to heels, avoiding any arching or rounding of your back.
ex_Y2HEBN.description: Alternate Single Leg Raise Plank is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors.

ex_WVFEJW.name: Alternate Toe Tap Leg Lift
instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Raise your torso off the floor by placing your elbows on the floor and raise one of your knees toward the chest while keeping your knee bent.
Lower your foot back to the floor while raising your other knee towards your chest.
Keep repeating by alternately moving your knees towards and away from the chest.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Focus on maintaining the bend in your knees and tapping the floor lightly to ensure proper form.
ex_WVFEJW.description: Alternate Toe Tap Leg Lift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_U5H4B5.name: Alternating Leg Lifts
instructions: Lie down on your back with your legs straight and hands behind your head.
Raise one of your legs straight towards the ceiling without bending your knee.
Slowly lower your leg back towards the floor and simultaneously raise the other leg.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed into the mat to maintain proper alignment and avoid strain.
Use a controlled breathing pattern: inhale as you lift your leg and exhale as you lower it.
Engage your thigh muscles to assist with the lift and maintain straight legs throughout the movement.
ex_U5H4B5.description: Alternating Leg Lifts is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_CCQC7K.name: Alternating Oblique Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows pointing outward.
Lift your shoulders off the mat and twist your torso to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Lower your shoulders back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands to prevent strain; use your core muscles to lift and twist your torso.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to ensure proper form and maximize effectiveness.
ex_CCQC7K.description: Alternating Oblique Sit-Ups is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_MFI5TU.name: Alternating Plank Lunge
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Step your right foot forward outside your right hand, bringing your body into a low lunge position.
Return your right foot to the plank position.
Step your left foot forward outside your left hand, bringing your body into a low lunge position. Return your left foot to the plank position. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper alignment.
Ensure your front knee is aligned with your ankle and does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
ex_MFI5TU.description: Alternating Plank Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Triceps.

ex_PQ5E5J.name: Alternating Toe Tap
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight on the floor and your arms resting by your sides.
Simultaneously lift your right leg and left arm towards the ceiling, trying to touch your toe with your hand.
Lower your right leg and left arm back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg and right arm, lifting them towards the ceiling and trying to touch your toe with your hand. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Keep your legs straight and avoid bending your knees to ensure proper form.
ex_PQ5E5J.description: Alternating Toe Tap is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Shoulders.

ex_HMVCDP.name: Arm Rotation Knee Lift
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight and feet shoulder-width apart.
Fold your arms at your sides and make fists with your hands near your chest.
Raise your right knee while rotating your torso to the left side and back to the right side.
Return to the initial position and repeat by raising your other knee.
tips: Focus on lifting your knee high to fully engage your hip flexors.
Use your oblique muscles to initiate the twist, enhancing the rotational movement.
Maintain an even pace to ensure both sides of your body are working evenly.
ex_HMVCDP.description: Arm Rotation Knee Lift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Shoulders.

ex_DHMGL4.name: Assisted Sit Ups
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor, with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, close together. Have your partner hold your feet, holding them securely for stability.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position with control. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lift your upper body towards your knees and inhale as you lower it back down.
Perform the exercise slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and effectiveness.
Keep your elbows out to the sides and avoid pulling on your neck with your hands.
ex_DHMGL4.description: Assisted Sit Ups is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_QUFMFB.name: Band Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat and secure a resistance band around both feet. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outward, and keep your legs extended straight.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the floor. Bend your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously twisting your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee.
Switch sides by bending your left knee towards your chest while bringing your right elbow towards your left knee, performing a pedaling motion.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use your abs to lift and twist your torso.
Ensure the resistance band is securely placed around your feet and on the equipment to avoid slipping.
Maintain a steady rhythm and focus on controlled movements rather than speed.
ex_QUFMFB.description: Band Bicycle Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_J657K2.name: Barbell Landmine Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the end of the landmine barbell at your side with your arm straight and your core engaged.
Slowly bend your torso toward the barbell while keeping your hips still and your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement without twisting your shoulders or hips.
Squeeze your obliques to return to the starting position, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
tips: Keep your working arm straight without shrugging your shoulder.
Keep your knees slightly bent to improve balance and stability.
Keep your torso facing forward throughout the movement. Move only through your waist and avoid rotating your shoulders or hips.
Exhale as you return to the upright position and inhale as you bend sideways.
ex_J657K2.description: Barbell Landmine Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Back, Forearms.

ex_FFKBPZ.name: Barbell Rollout
instructions: Begin by kneeling on a mat with a barbell placed in front of you. Grip the barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands shoulder-width apart.
Slowly roll the barbell forward, extending your arms and allowing your body to move forward.
Roll out as far as you can while maintaining control and a neutral spine. Your arms should be fully extended, and your body should be in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Engage your core and use your abdominal muscles to pull the barbell back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a strong core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and prevent injury.
Keep your back flat and avoid letting your hips sag to ensure proper form.
Control the rolling motion to maximize muscle engagement and prevent strain.
ex_FFKBPZ.description: Barbell Rollout is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

ex_NCFG7I.name: Barbell Seated Twist on Exercise Ball
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the floor, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Begin by rotating your torso to the right, keeping your hips and lower body stationary. Rotate until you feel a stretch in your obliques.
Reverse the movement, rotating your torso to the left, again keeping your hips and lower body stationary.
Repeat the rotation to both sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core muscles to stabilize your spine and maintain proper form.
Maintain an upright posture to avoid straining your lower back.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
ex_NCFG7I.description: Barbell Seated Twist on Exercise Ball is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

ex_NPGIT3.name: Barbell Seated Twist
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Begin by rotating your torso to the right, keeping your hips and lower body stationary. Rotate until you feel a stretch in your obliques.
Reverse the movement, rotating your torso to the left, again keeping your hips and lower body stationary.
Repeat the rotation to both sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core muscles to stabilize your spine and maintain proper form.
Maintain an upright posture to avoid straining your lower back.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
ex_NPGIT3.description: Barbell Seated Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

ex_TFKWQN.name: Barbell Side Bends
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Lean to the right side by bending at the waist, lowering your torso as far as is comfortable.
Return to the starting position by engaging your oblique muscles and straightening your torso.
Repeat the movement to the left side. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid twisting your torso during the movement to focus on the side bend.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you bend to each side and inhaling as you return to the center.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
ex_TFKWQN.description: Barbell Side Bends is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

ex_U5RCUM.name: Barbell Situp
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and hold a barbell directly above your chest with your arms fully extended, hands at shoulder width apart.
Keep the barbell locked out overhead as you raise your upper body into a seated position, using your core.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your arms straight and the barbell stable overhead.
Lower your torso back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms fully extended throughout the exercise for stability.
Maintain a straight bar path directly above your shoulders throughout the movement.
Use your abdominal muscles to crunch into a seated position. Control the lowering phase to maximize core engagement.
Inhale as you lower your torso and exhale as you sit up.
ex_U5RCUM.description: Barbell Situp is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Shoulders, Chest.

ex_4HSTT6.name: Barbell Standing Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping your hips and knees aligned with the movement.
Rotate back to the center position with control, then twist your torso to the left.
Continue alternating sides, repeating for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Rotate your torso, not just your arms, to effectively engage your oblique muscles.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you twist and inhaling as you return to the center position.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
ex_4HSTT6.description: Barbell Standing Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

ex_RKE2Z6.name: Bench Decline Ab Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, performing a crunch.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
tips: Keep your chin slightly tucked to maintain a neutral spine position and prevent neck strain.
Focus on squeezing your abdominal muscles at the top of the crunch to enhance muscle engagement.
Breathe out as you lift your body and breathe in as you lower it to maintain a steady rhythm and maximize oxygen flow.
ex_RKE2Z6.description: Bench Decline Ab Sit-Ups is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_4V6I6U.name: Bench Knee Tucks
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands placed beside your hips for support.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor with your legs extended straight out.
Pull your knees towards your chest, tucking them in while engaging your core.
Extend your legs back out to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper form.
Avoid using momentum; focus on using your abdominal muscles to pull your knees in.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you tuck your knees in and inhaling as you extend your legs out.
ex_4V6I6U.description: Bench Knee Tucks is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_LIS3I6.name: Bent Knee Lying Twist (On Stability Ball)
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your arms extended out to the sides to form a T shape.
Place your bent legs on top of an exercise ball.
Lower your bent knees to one side, keeping your torso and arms flat on the floor.
Then bring your knees back to the center and lower them to the opposite side. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your shoulders flat on the floor to maximize the stretch in your spine and obliques.
Move slowly and with control to avoid straining your back.
Breathe deeply and steadily, exhaling as you lower your knees to the side and inhaling as you bring them back to the center.
ex_LIS3I6.description: Bent Knee Lying Twist (On Stability Ball) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a stability ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Abdominals.

ex_ZAFSLJ.name: Bent Knee Lying Twist
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides, forming a T shape.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor, bringing your upper legs vertical to the floor.
Lower your bent knees to one side, keeping your torso and arms flat on the floor.
Then bring your knees back to the center and lower them to the opposite side. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your shoulders flat on the floor to maximize the stretch in your spine and obliques.
Move slowly and with control to avoid straining your back.
Breathe deeply and steadily, exhaling as you lower your knees to the side and inhaling as you bring them back to the center.
ex_ZAFSLJ.description: Bent Knee Lying Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Abdominals.

ex_7ZRMXP.name: Bicycle Twisting Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs raised at 45 degrees off the floor, keeping them straight.
Bring your right knee towards your chest while twisting your torso, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Alternate sides, bringing your left knee towards your chest and your right elbow towards your left knee, continuing in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to perform the twist, rather than your neck or shoulders.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to prevent strain.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use your core muscles to lift and twist your torso.
ex_7ZRMXP.description: Bicycle Twisting Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_SAIMA4.name: Bicycles Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs lifted off the floor.
Bring your right knee towards your chest while extending your left leg out.
Simultaneously twist your torso, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Alternate sides, bringing your left knee towards your chest and your right elbow towards your left knee, continuing in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to perform the twist, rather than your neck or shoulders.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to prevent strain.
Keep your elbows wide and avoid pulling on your head to prevent neck strain.
ex_SAIMA4.description: Bicycles Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_XSXBZN.name: Bicycles
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs bent and lifted off the floor, and both arms straight to the floor.
Bring your right knee towards your chest while straightening your left leg towards the floor without letting it touch the floor.
Alternate sides by bringing your left knee towards your chest and straightening your right leg towards the floor, continuing in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to control the movement of your legs.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to prevent strain.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and avoid injury.
ex_XSXBZN.description: Bicycles is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

ex_AZC5C7.name: Bottoms-Up Half Rep
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended just off the floor and your arms resting on the floor by your sides.
Bend your knees towards your chest, stopping when your upper legs are vertical to the floor.
Lower your legs back down without letting them touch the floor.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Focus on using your lower abdominal muscles to lift and lower your legs.
ex_AZC5C7.description: Bottoms-Up Half Rep is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_SWU6Y5.name: Brazilian Crunches
instructions: Begin in a plank position on your toes and hands, arms straight in line with shoulders, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your left elbow while lightly rotating your hips. Return your leg to starting position.

Repeat the movement on the opposite side, bending your left knee and bringing it towards your right elbow while lightly rotating your hips. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your movements controlled to ensure each repetition is deliberate and effective.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the plank.
Focus on maintaining proper plank form, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
ex_SWU6Y5.description: Brazilian Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_OLVQL3.name: Bridge - Mountain Climber (Cross Body)
instructions: Begin in a plank position on your toes and hands, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your left elbow while lightly rotating your hips, stop when your knee passes the elbow.
Return to the starting plank position, then repeat the movement on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure you keep your movements smooth and controlled to maintain form and avoid injury.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the plank position.
Keep your shoulders stable and your core engaged throughout the exercise to enhance effectiveness.
ex_OLVQL3.description: Bridge - Mountain Climber (Cross Body) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_BG4LUK.name: Cable Standing Crunch
instructions: Stand facing away from a high cable pulley with the rope positioned behind your neck. Hold the rope with arms beside your head with your feet shoulder width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Contract your abdominal muscles and curl your torso downward by bringing your rib cage toward your pelvis while keeping your hips nearly stationary.
Pause briefly at the bottom while squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Slowly return your torso to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hands beside your head without pulling on the rope with your arms.
Flex your spine to initiate the movement instead of hinging at your hips.
Keep your neck in a neutral position and avoid excessive forward head movement.
Inhale as you return to the starting position and exhale as you curl your torso downward.
ex_BG4LUK.description: Cable Standing Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_QO6DPM.name: Cable Twist (Up-Down)
instructions: Stand sideways to the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a handle to the high pulley and grasp it with both hands, arms extended diagonally along the cable.
Twist your torso down and across your body, pulling the handle down towards your opposite hip while keeping your arms straight.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Exhale as you twist away from the machine and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Minimize hip twisting to focus on engaging your obliques and core during the twist.
ex_QO6DPM.description: Cable Twist (Up-Down) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders.

ex_JIBZJU.name: Cable Twist
instructions: Stand sideways to the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a handle to the pulley at shoulder height and grasp it with both hands, arms extended in front of you.
Twist your torso away from the machine, pulling the handle across your body while keeping your arms straight.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Exhale as you twist away from the machine and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Minimize hip twisting to focus on engaging your obliques and core during the twist.
ex_JIBZJU.description: Cable Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders.

ex_K5GLME.name: Captains Chair Leg Raise
instructions: Stand on the platform of the captain's chair and place your forearms on the arm pads, gripping the handles for stability. Allow your legs to hang straight down.
Engage your core and keep your back pressed against the back pad.
Raise your legs, knees first, up in front of you until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your feet are slightly forward.
Slowly lower your knees back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you raise your knees and inhale as you lower them back down.
Avoid using momentum; the movement should be controlled and deliberate.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement.
ex_K5GLME.description: Captains Chair Leg Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_LOORBG.name: Captains Chair Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Stand on the platform of the captain's chair and place your forearms on the arm pads, gripping the handles for stability. Allow your legs to hang straight down.
Engage your core and keep your back pressed against the back pad.
Raise your legs straight up in front of you until they are parallel to the floor, keeping them as straight as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back pressed against the back pad to prevent swinging and maintain proper form.
Avoid using momentum; the movement should be controlled and deliberate.
Exhale as you raise your legs and inhale as you lower them back down.
ex_LOORBG.description: Captains Chair Straight Leg Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_7YPDRV.name: Chest Lift With Rotation
instructions: Begin by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows wide.
Engage your core and lift your upper body into a crunch position, holding the contraction at the top.
While holding the crunch, rotate your torso to the right. Return to the center.
Lower your upper body back to the floor, then repeat the movement, this time rotating to the left. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use your abdominal muscles to lift and rotate your torso.
Keep your elbows wide to ensure you are using your core muscles rather than your arms.
Make sure your lower back remains pressed against the floor throughout the exercise.
ex_7YPDRV.description: Chest Lift With Rotation is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_WS6WIO.name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and rest your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Place your top leg on a bench at knee or ankle height, with your bottom leg hanging free underneath.
Press your forearm and top leg down to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line, and raise your bottom leg toward the bench.
Hold the position while breathing steadily, then lower your hips with control and switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips stacked; don't let them roll forward or back.
Start with the bench under your knee and progress to the ankle as you get stronger.
ex_WS6WIO.description: Copenhagen Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_5LAQPZ.name: Crab Twist Toe Touch
instructions: Begin by sitting on the floor with your legs bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands placed behind you with your fingers pointing towards your body.
Engage your glutes and press through your palms and feet to lift your hips off the floor, creating a tabletop position with your body.
Simultaneously lift your right hand and left foot off the floor and twist your torso to reach your right hand towards your left foot, attempting to touch your left toe.

Return your hand and leg to the floor and repeat the movement on the opposite side by lifting your left hand and reaching towards your right foot. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the twist with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Ensure your shoulders remain down and away from your ears to avoid unnecessary strain.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you twist and reach towards your toe and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your hands and feet to prevent discomfort during the exercise.
ex_5LAQPZ.description: Crab Twist Toe Touch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.

ex_IRJF2U.name: Criss Cross Leg Raises
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your legs extended straight out and your arms resting by your sides or under your lower back for support. Engage your core and lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Start crisscrossing your legs in a scissor motion, crossing your right leg over your left and then your left leg over your right.

Gradually move your legs upward while continuing to crisscross until they form a 45-degree angle with your torso. Then, lower them back down to just above the floor, maintaining the crisscross motion throughout.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Focus on using your leg muscles to control the movement, keeping your legs straight and performing the crisscross motion smoothly.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to avoid unnecessary strain.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you move your legs upward and inhaling as you lower them.
ex_IRJF2U.description: Criss Cross Leg Raises is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

ex_IGC736.name: Crunch (Arms Straight)
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Extend your arms straight above your head, keeping them in line with your ears.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, reaching your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower your shoulder blades back to the floor with control, keeping your arms extended. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using your neck or momentum to lift your shoulders; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort during the exercise.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
ex_IGC736.description: Crunch (Arms Straight) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_6722QW.name: Crunch (Hands Overhead)
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Extend your arms straight overhead with hands close together, keeping them in line with your ears.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, reaching your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower your shoulder blades back to the floor with control, keeping your arms extended. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using your neck or momentum to lift your shoulders; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Perform the movement with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to avoid unnecessary strain.
ex_6722QW.description: Crunch (Hands Overhead) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_DEOJAD.name: Crunch (Legs on Stability Ball)
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and your lower legs resting on a stability ball.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor, curling your upper body towards your knees while keeping your legs stable on the ball.
Lower your shoulder blades back to the floor with control, maintaining your legs' position on the ball. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
ex_DEOJAD.description: Crunch (Legs on Stability Ball) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a stability ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_FY5RMG.name: Crunch (On BOSU Ball)
instructions: Begin by sitting on a BOSU ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Lean back to position your lower back against the BOSU ball, ensuring your upper body is supported. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades upwards, curling your upper body towards your knees.
Lower your shoulder blades back down with control, maintaining your core engagement. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Use a mat or soft surface under the BOSU ball if needed for additional stability and comfort.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Ensure your lower back remains in contact with the BOSU ball to avoid unnecessary strain.
ex_FY5RMG.description: Crunch (On BOSU Ball) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a bosu ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_HBZTCF.name: Crunch (On Stability Ball)
instructions: Begin by sitting on a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.

Walk your feet forward and lean back to position your lower and mid-back on the stability ball. Your upper body should be supported by the ball. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades upwards, curling your upper body towards your knees.
Lower your shoulder blades back down with control, maintaining your core engagement. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Ensure your lower back remains in contact with the stability ball to avoid unnecessary strain.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
ex_HBZTCF.description: Crunch (On Stability Ball) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a stability ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_JHITSA.name: Crunch (Straight Leg Up)
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your legs extended straight up towards the ceiling. Keep your feet together, and your arms extended straight above your chest.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, reaching your arms towards your toes.
Hold the crunch position briefly, squeezing your abdominal muscles at the top.
Lower your shoulder blades back to the floor with control, keeping your legs extended upward. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using your neck or momentum to lift your shoulders; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort during the exercise.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to avoid unnecessary strain.
ex_JHITSA.description: Crunch (Straight Leg Up) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_LEVSMJ.name: Crunch Floor
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, curling your upper body towards your knees.
Lower your shoulder blades back to the floor with control, maintaining your core engagement. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Perform the movement with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.

ex_FE5VDI.name: Crunch Frog on Floor
instructions: Begin seated on the floor, leaning back slightly. Your arms should be extended out to the sides at shoulder level, and your legs should be extended straight and parallel just above the floor.
Engage your core to simultaneously bring both knees towards your chest while lightly crunching your upper body towards your knees.
As you crunch, bring your arms together towards the sides of your knees.
Extend your legs back out and open your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your legs and upper body, avoiding excessive use of momentum.
Ensure your lower back remains stable and avoid arching it during the movement.

ex_STEBXR.name: Crunch With Medicine Ball

ex_FTZD5I.name: Dead Bug Extended Arms
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back, right arm extended overhead on the floor in line with your torso and left arm extended by your side. ex_7ALPEC.name: Dead Bug

ex_X3NOF3.name: Decline Bent Leg Reverse Crunch

ex_3G46NJ.name: Decline Sit Ups Dumbbells

ex_NJYJ64.name: Diagonal Chop Cable
instructions: Anchor one end of the band at chest height. Stand with your right side facing the anchor point, with your feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp the handle with both hands. Extend your arms to hold the handle opposite your chest.
Pull the handle down and diagonally across your body, twisting your torso and pivoting your back foot to follow through. Bring the handle down towards the left side.
