Sit upright with a long spine and gently rest your forearms on your top shin while relaxing your hips. Lean into your forearms applying slight pressure on the top leg.
Hold the stretch, then uncross your legs with control and repeat with the opposite leg on top.
tips: Relax your hips and allow your knees to lower naturally without forcing them.
If one hip lifts off the floor, reduce the depth of the position until both hips are evenly supported.
Stack your shins as evenly as your flexibility allows.
Inhale as you lengthen your spine and exhale as you relax deeper into the stretch.
ex_QHW5IH.description: Double Pigeon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hip Flexors.

ex_KQMQJ3.name: Downward Dog Toe to Heel
instructions: Stand upright with your feet at shoulder width apart and raise both arms overhead. Bend forward, place your hands on the floor, in front of your feet with a slight bend in your knees.
Walk your feet backward until your body forms an inverted V shape. Keep your hands and feet at shoulder width apart, and lift your hips upward.
Press your left heel into the floor as you bend the right knee, placing your foot in a position where the toes of your right foot align with heel of your left leg.
Hold for a few seconds, then walk your feet back to the starting position. Stand up and alternate sides.
tips: Press firmly through your palms and spread your fingers for stability.
Keep your neck relaxed and your gaze directed toward your feet or between your legs.
Lift your hips upward to lengthen your spine throughout the movement.
Inhale as you prepare and exhale each time you press a heel toward the floor.
ex_KQMQJ3.description: Downward Dog Toe to Heel is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core, Upper Back.

ex_WTRVI6.name: Downward Dog With Fingers Facing Feet
instructions: Stand upright with your feet at shoulder width apart and raise both arms overhead. Bend forward, place your hands on the floor, with your fingers pointing at your feet and a slight bend in your knees.
Walk your feet backward until your body forms an inverted V shape. Keep your hands and feet planted on the floor, lifting your hips upward.
Straighten your arms and legs, keeping a slight bend in each joint as you lift your hips toward the ceiling and gently press your chest toward your thighs.
Hold the stretch, then walk your feet back toward your hands and slowly return to a standing position.
tips: Spread your fingers and press evenly through your palms to support your wrists.
Reduce the amount of hand rotation if you feel discomfort in your wrists.
Keep your head relaxed between your arms.
Inhale as you move into the stretch and exhale as you deepen it.
ex_WTRVI6.description: Downward Dog With Fingers Facing Feet is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Upper Back, Hamstrings.

ex_73JV5H.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell across your hips with both hands. Extend your left leg straight out in front of you, keeping it in line with your right thigh.
Engage your core and squeeze your glutes. Drive through your right heel to lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your right knee.
Hold the top position briefly, squeezing your glutes and maintaining a straight line with your body.
Lower your hips back to the starting position with control, ensuring your left leg remains extended. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
tips: Ensure your shoulders, hips, and knees form a straight line at the top of the movement.
Drive through your heel to maximize glute activation.
Avoid overarching your lower back; keep the movement focused on your glutes and hamstrings.
ex_73JV5H.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_WD2ZCB.name: Eagle Arms Chin Into Chest
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Raise both arms outward to shoulder height, then bring them forward in front of your chest.
Cross one upper arm over the other at the elbows, bend both elbows, and wrap your forearms around each other until the back of your hands press together.
Lift your elbows in front of your face, gently tuck your chin toward your chest, and allow your upper back to round slightly until you feel a stretch across your shoulders, upper back, and neck.
Hold the position briefly, then lift your head, unwrap your arms, and return them to your sides. Repeat with the opposite arm crossed on top.
tips: Wrap your forearms only as far as your shoulder mobility comfortably allows.
Press the backs of your arms together if your hands cannot meet.
Keep your elbows lifted while gently drawing your shoulder blades apart.
Inhale as you prepare and exhale as you tuck your chin and deepen the stretch.
ex_WD2ZCB.description: Eagle Arms Chin Into Chest is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Neck, Middle Back.

ex_VK5DLT.name: Easy Pose Neck Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart, your shoulders relaxed, and your arms resting by your sides.
Raise one arm over your head and place your hand gently above the opposite ear
Slowly draw your head toward the raised-arm side, bringing your ear toward your shoulder while keeping your opposite shoulder lowered and your torso upright.
Hold the stretch, then release your head gradually and lower your arm before repeating on the opposite side.
tips: Draw your head gently toward your shoulder instead of pulling forcefully.
Keep your spine tall and avoid rounding your upper back.
Stop if you feel pinching, dizziness, or discomfort in your neck.
Inhale before tilting your head and exhale as you relax into the stretch.
ex_VK5DLT.description: Easy Pose Neck Stretch is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the levator scapulae (neck). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

ex_LXJRIW.name: Easy Seated Twist Pose
instructions: Sit upright with your legs crossed, placing your shins parallel to each other. Rest both hands on your leg on top and lengthen your spine.
Rotate your torso to one side, placing the back of your opposite forearm above your knee, and position your other hand on the floor behind your hips for support.
Keep your hips grounded as you rotate your chest and shoulders toward your rear hand, then gently turn your head to look over the same shoulder.
Hold the stretch, return your torso and head to the center with control, then reverse your hand placement and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Position your rear hand close to your body to support an upright posture.
Rotate through your torso without forcing the movement with your arms.
Use the hand on your opposite knee only as a gentle guide.
Inhale as you lengthen your spine and exhale as you rotate deeper into the stretch.
ex_LXJRIW.description: Easy Seated Twist Pose is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Lower Back, Upper Back.

ex_LV77O4.name: Extended Side Angle Pose With Block
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and place a yoga block vertically in front of your right toes. Step your left foot back and out to the side into a wide stance, turning your foot outward. Keep your left leg extended, and bend your right knee.
Lean your torso toward your right thigh and place your right hand on top of the block, using it for light support while keeping both feet firmly planted.
Rotate your chest open, raising your left arm toward the ceiling, then bend your elbow and reach your forearm over your head to lengthen the side of your torso.

Hold the position, then raise your left arm toward the ceiling, lift your torso upright, straighten your right leg, and step your left foot forward. Repeat on the opposite side with the block positioned in front of your left toes.
tips: Place only light pressure through your right hand instead of leaning heavily on the block.
Keep both feet firmly planted and maintain a stable, wide stance.
Keep your right knee aligned with your right toes without allowing it to collapse inward.
Inhale as you rotate your chest open and exhale as you reach your arm over your head.
ex_LV77O4.description: Extended Side Angle Pose With Block is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Quadriceps, Glutes.

ex_WFNRK3.name: Extended Side Angle Pose
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart, then step one foot back and out to the side into a wide stance. Turn your back foot outward and keep your back leg extended, while bending the knee of your front leg.
Lean your torso toward your front thigh and place your same-side hand on the floor inside your front foot, keeping both feet firmly planted.
Rotate your chest open, raise your opposite arm toward the ceiling, then bend your elbow and reach your forearm over your head to lengthen the side of your torso.
Hold the position, then straighten your upper arm, lift your torso, straighten your front leg, and step back to the starting position before repeating on the opposite side.
tips: Use your lower hand lightly for balance instead of placing all your weight through it.
Rotate your chest upward and avoid allowing your upper shoulder to roll forward.
Keep your hips stable as you lengthen your upper arm over your head.
Inhale as you open your chest and exhale as you deepen the side stretch.
ex_WFNRK3.description: Extended Side Angle Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes, Hamstrings.

ex_JTYSMS.name: Extended Side Angle
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart, about 3-4 feet, with your right foot turned out 90 degrees and your left foot slightly turned in. Place your hands on your hips.
Bend your right knee, ensuring it aligns over your right ankle, and lower your right thigh until it is parallel to the floor. Extend your left leg straight.

Lean to your right side by bending your right knee further and place your right elbow on your right thigh. Raise your left arm overhead, creating a straight line from your left hand to your left foot.
Hold the position for a moment, then return to the starting position with control. Repeat on the other side.
tips: Ensure your bent knee is aligned with your ankle to avoid strain on the knee joint.
Only stretch as far as is comfortable without causing pain or discomfort.
Focus on deep, steady breathing, inhaling as you extend into the stretch and exhaling as you hold the stretch.
Use a yoga block or modify the hand placement if needed for additional support.
ex_JTYSMS.description: Extended Side Angle is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Shoulders.

ex_V56GYO.name: Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up
instructions: Begin in a tall kneeling position. Extend your left leg straight out to the side for support and place your right hand on the floor directly under your shoulder.
Keep your right knee under your hip and your extended leg straight as you lean to the side.
Rotate your chest upward and extend your left arm over your head. Turn your head and look up toward ceiling.
Hold the stretch, then lower your left arm and return upright. Repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Press evenly through your right palm for support.
Rotate your chest upward without allowing your hips to roll backward.
Look upward only as far as your neck remains comfortable.
Inhale while upright and exhale as you lean to the side.
ex_V56GYO.description: Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Middle Back, Shoulders, Core.

ex_API3EM.name: Gate Pose Variation Arm Extended on Side
instructions: Begin in a tall kneeling position, then extend your left leg straight out to the side for support.
Lean to your right and place your right hand on the floor directly under your shoulder, with your arm extended.
Extend your left arm over your head while keeping your chest and gaze facing forward.
Hold the stretch, then return upright and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward without rotating upward.
Keep your supporting knee directly below your hip.
Keep your hips stable as you bend to the side.
Inhale while upright, then exhale as you lean and extend your arm over your head.
ex_API3EM.description: Gate Pose Variation Arm Extended on Side is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Middle Back, Shoulders, Core.

ex_3OHRJY.name: Half Lotus
instructions: Sit upright on the floor with both legs extended in front of you.
Bend your left knee and place your left ankle above your right knee so your shins are perpendicular to each other.
Support your left foot with your right hand and place your left hand on your left knee.
Gently press your left knee downward while keeping your torso upright, then release and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Place your ankle just above your knee, not directly on the kneecap.
Press the knee of your working leg downward gently without forcing it.
Keep your spine tall and your shoulders relaxed.
Inhale while sitting upright and exhale as you gently press your knee downward.
ex_3OHRJY.description: Half Lotus is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Adductors.

ex_IPGY66.name: Half Monkey Pose
instructions: Begin in a tall kneeling position, then extend one leg forward with your heel on the floor and your toes pointing upward.
Keep your hips stable above your kneeling knee as you straighten your front leg, keeping your heel on the floor.
Lean forward over your straight leg and place both hands on the floor beside your foot.
Hold the stretch. Return to the starting position, then repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Point your front toes upward to deepen the calf and hamstring stretch.
Position your rear knee comfortably beneath your hip.
Use your hands lightly for support without placing excessive weight through them.
Inhale while you are in the upright position and exhale as you lean forward.
ex_IPGY66.description: Half Monkey Pose is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Glutes, Lower Back.

ex_Z3ARRE.name: Happy Baby
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees toward your chest, and hold the outside of each foot with your hands.
Open your knees wider than your torso and raise your feet so the soles face upward.
Gently pull your feet downward while keeping your head, shoulders, and lower back on the floor.
Hold the stretch, then release your feet and return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your ankles positioned above your knees.
Draw your knees toward the sides of your torso.
Use a comfortable range without forcing your hips or knees.
Inhale as you prepare and exhale as you deepen the stretch.
ex_Z3ARRE.description: Happy Baby is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Lower Back.

ex_IZRBLY.name: High Plank
instructions: Begin on the floor on your hands and knees. Position your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Extend your legs straight back, one at a time, coming onto the balls of your feet to form a straight line from your head to your heels. Your body should be in a high plank position.
Engage your core, glutes, and legs to maintain a straight body line. Keep your shoulders directly over your wrists.
Hold the plank position for the desired amount of time, maintaining proper form and steady breathing.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent sagging or arching of your back.
Ensure your hands are positioned directly under your shoulders to support your weight evenly.
Breathe steadily, inhaling through your nose and exhaling through your mouth to help maintain focus and endurance.
ex_IZRBLY.description: High Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.

ex_VNFGRS.name: Lord of the Dance
instructions: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot or ankle behind you.
Reach your free arm forward.
Kick your foot back into your hand as you tilt your torso forward.
Hold the balance, then switch sides.
tips: Focus your eyes on one point for balance.
Keep the standing knee soft.
ex_VNFGRS.description: Lord of the Dance is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Shoulders, Core.

ex_SLBULC.name: Modified Hindu Push Up
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart. Your body should form a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping your body straight.
Push through your hands to raise your hips up and back into a downward-facing dog position, forming an inverted V-shape with your body.
Lower your hips and return to the plank position by moving your body forward. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core to maintain a straight body line during the plank position and prevent your hips from sagging.
Lower your chest towards the floor with controlled movement to ensure proper muscle engagement and avoid injury.
As you push into the downward-facing dog, focus on driving your hips upward while keeping your arms and legs as straight as possible.
ex_SLBULC.description: Modified Hindu Push Up is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Upper Back, Lower Back.

ex_ZQALQL.name: Monkey Pose
instructions: From a low lunge, slowly slide your front heel forward and your back knee back.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor or on blocks.
Lower your hips toward the floor in a split, as far as is comfortable.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Use blocks under your hands and hips.
Never force the split.
ex_ZQALQL.description: Monkey Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes.

ex_35EKVQ.name: One Arm Cow Face Pose - Easy
instructions: Sit or stand tall.
Reach one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your back.
With your other hand, gently press the bent elbow back.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your head upright.
Use a strap if needed.
ex_35EKVQ.description: One Arm Cow Face Pose - Easy is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lats.

ex_CUI2XL.name: Pigeon Glutes Stretch
instructions: From a plank or all fours, bring one knee forward behind your wrist with the shin angled across.
Extend the other leg straight back.
Lower your hips toward the floor and fold forward over your front leg.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Put a cushion under your hip if it doesn't reach the floor.
Keep your hips level.
ex_CUI2XL.description: Pigeon Glutes Stretch is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_CIHSM2.name: Pigeon Pose
instructions: From all fours, bring one knee forward toward your wrist with the shin angled across your body.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Lower your hips and keep your chest lifted.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Square your hips toward the front.
Use a block under your hip if needed.
ex_CIHSM2.description: Pigeon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

ex_WYZEH4.name: Puppy Pose
instructions: Start on all fours.
Walk your hands forward, keeping your hips over your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Rest your forehead down and hold, breathing slowly.
tips: Keep your arms active.
Let your chest melt toward the floor.
ex_WYZEH4.description: Puppy Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Chest.

ex_N4MBZI.name: Pyramid Pose - Parsvottanasana
instructions: Stand with one foot forward and the other back, feet about 3 feet apart and the back foot turned out slightly.
Square your hips toward the front.
Hinge forward over your front leg with a long spine.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Bend your front knee slightly if needed.
Lead with your chest.
ex_N4MBZI.description: Pyramid Pose - Parsvottanasana is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Lower Back.

ex_TGLGVV.name: Pyramid Pose Blocks
instructions: Stand in a split stance with yoga blocks on either side of your front foot.
Square your hips forward.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the blocks.
Hold with a long spine, then switch sides.
tips: Raise the blocks if your back rounds.
Keep both legs active.
ex_TGLGVV.description: Pyramid Pose Blocks is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Lower Back.

ex_7MT35N.name: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the ball of your front foot raised on a block.
Square your hips forward.
Hinge forward over the front leg.
Hold, feeling the stretch in your calf and hamstring, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your heel down on the floor.
Go only as far as is comfortable.
ex_7MT35N.description: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_LSBESR.name: Pyramid Prayer
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the back foot turned out slightly.
Join your palms behind your back in a reverse prayer, or hold your elbows.
Hinge forward over the front leg with a long spine.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Hold your elbows if reverse prayer is too intense.
Keep your chest open.
ex_LSBESR.description: Pyramid Prayer is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.

ex_44XEBQ.name: Reclining Pigeon Pose
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh.
Pull the lower leg toward your chest by holding behind the thigh.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Flex the foot of the crossed leg to protect the knee.
ex_44XEBQ.description: Reclining Pigeon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_I4WQ5P.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge Abduction
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a loop resistance band just above your knees. Keep your hands extended by your sides with hands firm on the floor.
Engage your core and glutes, and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
While holding the bridge position, press your knees outward against the resistance band to stretch them as far as possible.
Slowly bring your knees back together, then lower your hips back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back; keep a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Focus on engaging your glutes and hip abductors throughout the movement.
Exhale as you lift your hips and press your knees outward, and inhale as you bring your knees back together and lower your hips .
ex_I4WQ5P.description: Resistance Band Glute Bridge Abduction is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Abductors, Core, Hamstrings.

ex_LROHZD.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge (Version 2)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a loop resistance band just above your knees. Bring your hands close to your chest and interlock your fingers.
Engage your core and glutes, and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Hold the bridge position for a moment, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back; keep a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Focus on engaging your glutes throughout the movement.
Exhale as you lift your hips and press your knees outward, and inhale as you bring your knees back together and lower your hips .
ex_LROHZD.description: Resistance Band Glute Bridge (Version 2) is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Hamstrings, Abductors.

ex_QLNSOF.name: Resistance Band Upper Body Dead Bug
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle, knees right above your hips. Attach two loop resistance bands at a low point, extending behind you.
Hold the end of each band in each hand, keeping your arms extended straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower your right leg towards the floor while keeping your left leg and arms in the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lower your leg and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor to avoid strain.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement.
ex_QLNSOF.description: Resistance Band Upper Body Dead Bug is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_55BLBP.name: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs
instructions: Sit and stack one knee on top of the other, with your feet beside your hips.
Sit evenly on both sit bones.
Fold forward over your knees, or stay upright.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch the top leg.
tips: Sit on a cushion if your hips are tight.
Don't force your knees together.
ex_55BLBP.description: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_PLVNAX.name: Reverse Prayer
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Bring your hands behind your back and join your palms with your fingers pointing up.
Press your palms together and open your chest.
Hold, breathing slowly.
tips: Hold opposite elbows as an easier version.
Keep your shoulders back.
ex_PLVNAX.description: Reverse Prayer is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

ex_7IPBGT.name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner
instructions: Step into a lunge and lower your back knee to the floor.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and place your opposite elbow outside your front knee.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep the back knee down for stability.
Twist gradually with each breath.
ex_7IPBGT.description: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_5TWD7N.name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands
instructions: Step into a lunge with your front knee over your ankle.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your opposite elbow outside your front knee.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Lengthen your spine before you twist.
Lower your back knee to make it easier.
ex_5TWD7N.description: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hip Flexors.

ex_MLYJ5Z.name: Runners Lunge
instructions: From standing, step one foot far back into a lunge.
Place your hands on the floor beside your front foot.
Lower your hips and extend your back leg.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Lower your back knee to rest.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
ex_MLYJ5Z.description: Runners Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Glutes.

ex_SZSEQA.name: Scapula Push Up
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Keep your feet hip-width apart.
Without bending your elbows, squeeze your shoulder blades together, allowing your chest to lower slightly towards the floor.
Push your shoulder blades apart, rounding your upper back slightly and lifting your chest away from the floor.
Continue to alternate between the retraction and protraction phases for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a steady and controlled movement.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you protract and inhaling as you retract your shoulder blades.
Maintain a straight body line, avoiding any sagging or arching of the back.
Perform the exercise on a stable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and prevent slipping.
ex_SZSEQA.description: Scapula Push Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.

ex_6THYMR.name: Scorpion Twist Pose
instructions: Lie face down with your arms stretched out to the sides.
Bend one knee.
Lift and rotate that leg across your body toward the opposite hand.
Return and switch sides.
tips: Keep both shoulders on the floor.
Move slowly.
ex_6THYMR.description: Scorpion Twist Pose is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Glutes.

ex_PUE3OP.name: Seated Cross Leg Glute Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Bend your right knee and cross your right leg over your left thigh and lightly bend your left knee placing your left foot flat on the floor.
Keeping your back straight, lower your chest towards your crossed leg, reaching your hands straight to the floor to deepen the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your right glute. Slowly release and return to the starting position. Repeat on the left side.
tips: Maintain a straight back as you lower your chest to enhance the effectiveness of the stretch.

instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.

ex_IOEZED.name: Side Lying Parsva Savasana Variation

ex_GT4XLP.name: Side Plank With Hip Lift
instructions: Begin in a side plank position on your right side, with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder. Raise your left arm straight toward the ceiling.

ex_A2CS6P.name: Superman Holds

ex_NQLLRP.description: Alternate Toe Tap Leg Lift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_Q63EIW.name: Alternating Leg Lifts
instructions: Lie down on your back with your legs straight and hands behind your head.
Raise one of your legs straight towards the ceiling without bending your knee.
Slowly lower your leg back towards the floor and simultaneously raise the other leg.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed into the mat to maintain proper alignment and avoid strain.
Use a controlled breathing pattern: inhale as you lift your leg and exhale as you lower it.
Engage your thigh muscles to assist with the lift and maintain straight legs throughout the movement.
ex_Q63EIW.description: Alternating Leg Lifts is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_5S3QTN.name: Alternating Oblique Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows pointing outward.
Lift your shoulders off the mat and twist your torso to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Lower your shoulders back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands to prevent strain; use your core muscles to lift and twist your torso.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to ensure proper form and maximize effectiveness.
ex_5S3QTN.description: Alternating Oblique Sit-Ups is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_3RT3C2.name: Alternating Plank Lunge
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Step your right foot forward outside your right hand, bringing your body into a low lunge position.
Return your right foot to the plank position.
Step your left foot forward outside your left hand, bringing your body into a low lunge position. Return your left foot to the plank position. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper alignment.
Ensure your front knee is aligned with your ankle and does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
ex_3RT3C2.description: Alternating Plank Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Triceps.

ex_RTEGRK.name: Alternating Toe Tap
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight on the floor and your arms resting by your sides.
Simultaneously lift your right leg and left arm towards the ceiling, trying to touch your toe with your hand.
Lower your right leg and left arm back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg and right arm, lifting them towards the ceiling and trying to touch your toe with your hand. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Keep your legs straight and avoid bending your knees to ensure proper form.
ex_RTEGRK.description: Alternating Toe Tap is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Shoulders.

ex_VWZQ5A.name: Assisted Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet secured with a partner holding them down.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, performing a sit-up.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your body, not your momentum.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands to prevent strain; use your core muscles to lift your body.
Keep a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you lift and inhaling as you lower your body.
ex_VWZQ5A.description: Assisted Sit-Up is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_KFODCP.name: Ball Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the floor and knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lean back, rolling the ball under your lower back, and place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body upwards until vertical to the floor.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position, repeat.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper form.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands to prevent strain; use your core muscles to lift your body.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
ex_KFODCP.description: Ball Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a stability ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_674XEC.name: Band Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat and secure a resistance band around both feet. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outward, and keep your legs extended straight.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the floor. Bend your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously twisting your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee.
Switch sides by bending your left knee towards your chest while bringing your right elbow towards your left knee, performing a pedaling motion.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use your abs to lift and twist your torso.
Ensure the resistance band is securely placed around your feet and on the equipment to avoid slipping.
Maintain a steady rhythm and focus on controlled movements rather than speed.
ex_674XEC.description: Band Bicycle Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_XWJLOO.name: Band Decline Sit Up
instructions: Secure the middle of the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point behind the headrest of a decline bench. Lie on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads and hold one handle of the band in each hand, positioning the band over your shoulders.
Contract your abs and lift your upper body up towards your knees, bringing your chest towards your thighs until you are in a seated position.
Slowly lower your upper body down the bench, maintaining control and tension in the band until your back rests on the bench.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored behind the headrest to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you lift your upper body and inhale as you lower it back down.
Avoid pulling on the band with your arms; focus on using your abs to lift your body.
ex_XWJLOO.description: Band Decline Sit Up is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_KDM2JO.name: Band Kneeling Crunch
instructions: Secure the middle of the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point above head height. Kneel on the floor facing away of the anchor point, holding one handle of the band in each hand with your hands positioned at the sides of your head.
Engage your core and bend at the waist, bringing your elbows towards your knees in a controlled crunch motion.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, ensuring a full contraction of your abdominal muscles.
Slowly return to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your abs to pull your torso down rather than your arms.
Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you crunch down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
ex_KDM2JO.description: Band Kneeling Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

ex_CSGIWN.name: Band Side Bend
instructions: Anchor one end of the band at a low point of the equipment. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, your right side leaning to the anchor point, holding the other end of the resistance band in your right hand. Allow your left hand to hang by your side for counterbalance.
Contract your left obliques to bend at the waist to your left side until you are upright.
Return to the starting position with control.
Repeat the movement for the desired repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Engage your core to help stabilize your body and prevent unnecessary movement.
Avoid bending forward or backward; focus on bending directly to the side.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you bend to the side and inhaling as you return to the upright position.
ex_CSGIWN.description: Band Side Bend is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

ex_TN6RDO.name: Barbell Landmine Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the end of the landmine barbell at your side with your arm straight and your core engaged.
Slowly bend your torso toward the barbell while keeping your hips still and your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement without twisting your shoulders or hips.
Squeeze your obliques to return to the starting position, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
tips: Keep your working arm straight without shrugging your shoulder.
Keep your knees slightly bent to improve balance and stability.
Keep your torso facing forward throughout the movement. Move only through your waist and avoid rotating your shoulders or hips.
Exhale as you return to the upright position and inhale as you bend sideways.
ex_TN6RDO.description: Barbell Landmine Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Back, Forearms.

ex_ZWTSA3.name: Barbell Situp
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and hold a barbell directly above your chest with your arms fully extended, hands at shoulder width apart.
Keep the barbell locked out overhead as you raise your upper body into a seated position, using your core.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your arms straight and the barbell stable overhead.
Lower your torso back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms fully extended throughout the exercise for stability.
Maintain a straight bar path directly above your shoulders throughout the movement.
Use your abdominal muscles to crunch into a seated position. Control the lowering phase to maximize core engagement.
Inhale as you lower your torso and exhale as you sit up.
ex_ZWTSA3.description: Barbell Situp is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Shoulders, Chest.

ex_GJKJ6L.name: Bench Decline Ab Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, performing a crunch.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
tips: Keep your chin slightly tucked to maintain a neutral spine position and prevent neck strain.
Focus on squeezing your abdominal muscles at the top of the crunch to enhance muscle engagement.
Breathe out as you lift your body and breathe in as you lower it to maintain a steady rhythm and maximize oxygen flow.
ex_GJKJ6L.description: Bench Decline Ab Sit-Ups is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_MNMFLU.name: Bench Knee Tucks
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands placed beside your hips for support.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor with your legs extended straight out.
Pull your knees towards your chest, tucking them in while engaging your core.
Extend your legs back out to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper form.
Avoid using momentum; focus on using your abdominal muscles to pull your knees in.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you tuck your knees in and inhaling as you extend your legs out.
ex_MNMFLU.description: Bench Knee Tucks is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_SXLWAV.name: Bicycles Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs lifted off the floor.
Bring your right knee towards your chest while extending your left leg out.
Simultaneously twist your torso, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Alternate sides, bringing your left knee towards your chest and your right elbow towards your left knee, continuing in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to perform the twist, rather than your neck or shoulders.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to prevent strain.
Keep your elbows wide and avoid pulling on your head to prevent neck strain.
ex_SXLWAV.description: Bicycles Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_WGRHDS.name: Bicycles
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs bent and lifted off the floor, and both arms straight to the floor.
Bring your right knee towards your chest while straightening your left leg towards the floor without letting it touch the floor.
Alternate sides by bringing your left knee towards your chest and straightening your right leg towards the floor, continuing in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to control the movement of your legs.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to prevent strain.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and avoid injury.
ex_WGRHDS.description: Bicycles is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

ex_YLZWV6.name: Brazilian Crunches
instructions: Begin in a plank position on your toes and hands, arms straight in line with shoulders, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your left elbow while lightly rotating your hips. Return your leg to starting position.

Repeat the movement on the opposite side, bending your left knee and bringing it towards your right elbow while lightly rotating your hips. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your movements controlled to ensure each repetition is deliberate and effective.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the plank.
Focus on maintaining proper plank form, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
ex_YLZWV6.description: Brazilian Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_E7ATVB.name: Cable Standing Crunch
instructions: Stand facing away from a high cable pulley with the rope positioned behind your neck. Hold the rope with arms beside your head with your feet shoulder width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Contract your abdominal muscles and curl your torso downward by bringing your rib cage toward your pelvis while keeping your hips nearly stationary.
Pause briefly at the bottom while squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Slowly return your torso to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hands beside your head without pulling on the rope with your arms.
Flex your spine to initiate the movement instead of hinging at your hips.
Keep your neck in a neutral position and avoid excessive forward head movement.
Inhale as you return to the starting position and exhale as you curl your torso downward.
ex_E7ATVB.description: Cable Standing Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_HZM5OM.name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and rest your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Place your top leg on a bench at knee or ankle height, with your bottom leg hanging free underneath.
Press your forearm and top leg down to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line, and raise your bottom leg toward the bench.
Hold the position while breathing steadily, then lower your hips with control and switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips stacked; don't let them roll forward or back.
Start with the bench under your knee and progress to the ankle as you get stronger.
ex_HZM5OM.description: Copenhagen Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_Z2JVKW.name: Dead Bug Extended Arms
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back, right arm extended overhead on the floor in line with your torso and left arm extended by your side. Right knee bent close to your chest, while the left leg is bent and lightly extended away from your hips level, keeping both lower legs parallel to the floor.

In a semi circular motion bring your right arm to your side while slowly extending your right leg to pass your hip level and simultaneously bring your left arm in a semi circular motion extended overhead on the floor in line with your torso and your left knee closer to your chest.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm and leg, lowering the arm extended by your side and the opposite leg. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lower your arm and leg and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Avoid letting your leg touch the floor; keep it just above the floor to maintain tension in your muscles.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort during the exercise.
ex_Z2JVKW.description: Dead Bug Extended Arms is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_Y2SKAV.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your arms extended straight up towards the ceiling and your legs lifted with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and slowly lower your right arm and left leg towards the floor, keeping your back flat on the floor and not allowing it to arch.
Return your right arm and left leg to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Avoid letting your leg touch the floor; keep it just above the floor to maintain tension in your muscles.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to avoid unnecessary strain.
ex_Y2SKAV.description: Dead Bug is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_ONZXCD.name: Decline Levitating Sit Ups Bodyweight
instructions: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured under the footpads. Position your torso so it is parallel to the floor, 'levitating' off the bench.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, keeping your back straight and avoiding pulling on your neck.
Lower your upper body back to the starting position with control, maintaining the parallel position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Ensure your lower back remains off the bench and parallel to the floor to engage your core muscles effectively.
Use a stable decline bench to prevent any movement or slipping during the exercise.
ex_ONZXCD.description: Decline Levitating Sit Ups Bodyweight is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_ACRMBZ.name: Decline Sit Ups Dumbbells
instructions: Secure your feet at the end of a decline bench and lie back with your knees slightly bent. Hold a dumbbell in each hand close to your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the bench by contracting your abdominal muscles.
Continue to lift your upper body until you are in a seated position, ensuring that the contraction is felt in your abs.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position with control, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your body, rather than relying on momentum.
Breathe out as you sit up and breathe in as you return to the starting position.
Keep your feet securely anchored to the bench to stabilize your body throughout the exercise.
ex_ACRMBZ.description: Decline Sit Ups Dumbbells is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Hip Flexors.

ex_3YM4EE.name: Diagonal Chop Cable
instructions: Anchor one end of the band at chest height. Stand with your right side facing the anchor point, with your feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp the handle with both hands. Extend your arms to hold the handle opposite your chest.
Pull the handle down and diagonally across your body, twisting your torso and pivoting your back foot to follow through. Bring the handle down towards the left side.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides to work in the opposite direction
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Exhale as you pull the handle down and across your body, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Use a lighter weight if needed to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
ex_3YM4EE.description: Diagonal Chop Cable is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core, Hip Flexors.

ex_BTVLFP.name: Diagonal Chop Left
instructions: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended opposite your chest.
Rotate your torso and simultaneously bring your hands diagonally across your body towards your left hip, bending your knees slightly as you turn.
Keep your arms extended and pivot your right foot as you rotate to protect your knee from strain.
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner, bringing your hands back opposite your chest.
tips: Engage your core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and enhance power.
Pivot on your feet during the rotation to ensure a full range of motion and to reduce stress on your knees.
Focus on exhaling as you chop down and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to aid in balance and prevent strain on your joints.
ex_BTVLFP.description: Diagonal Chop Left is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Arms.

ex_7UEXDZ.name: Diagonal Chop Right
instructions: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended opposite your chest.
Rotate your torso and simultaneously bring your hands diagonally across your body towards your right hip, bending your knees slightly as you turn.
Keep your arms extended and pivot your right foot as you rotate to protect your knee from strain.
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner, bringing your hands back opposite your chest.
tips: Engage your core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and enhance power.
Pivot on your feet during the rotation to ensure a full range of motion and to reduce stress on your knees.
Focus on exhaling as you chop down and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to aid in balance and prevent strain on your joints.
ex_7UEXDZ.description: Diagonal Chop Right is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Arms.

ex_FMDLWI.name: Dragonfly
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead and grasp a stable support. Extend your legs straight together and hold them just above the floor.
Engage your core and lift both legs upward while rolling your hips off the floor until your body is supported on your shoulders.
Slowly lower your hips back to the floor, then continue lowering your straight legs until they are just above the floor without touching it.
Repeat the movement with controlled, continuous motion while keeping your legs together and as straight as possible.
tips: Keep your legs together throughout the entire movement.
Lift your hips by engaging your core rather than using momentum.
Lower your legs slowly to maintain tension in your abdominal muscles.
Inhale as you lower your legs and exhale as you lift them upward.
ex_FMDLWI.description: Dragonfly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back, Forearms.

ex_AZ6U42.name: Dumbbell Ab Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Hold a dumbbell with both hands straight over your chest.
Lift your head, shoulders, and upper back off the floor by contracting your abdominal muscles.
Raise the dumbbell towards the ceiling as you perform the crunch, keeping your arms straight. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position, keeping control of the movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to avoid straining it.
Avoid using your neck muscles to lift your head; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Breathe out as you lift your upper body and breathe in as you lower it.
ex_AZ6U42.description: Dumbbell Ab Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_S6H6OT.name: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit-Up
instructions: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured, holding a dumbbell in each hand extended overhead.
Slowly lift your shoulders, and upper back off the bench while simultaneously bringing the dumbbells up and over your head.
Continue to lift your torso until you are in an upright position with the dumbbell directly above your head.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position, keeping the dumbbells extended overhead.
tips: Keep your neck in a neutral position to avoid strain.
Focus on a smooth and controlled motion to maximize core engagement.
Avoid using momentum to lift yourself; rely on your core muscles.
ex_S6H6OT.description: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_ON5PGC.name: Dumbbell Diagonal Chop
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands extended opposite your chest.
Rotate your torso and lower the dumbbell diagonally across your body to the left side, extending your arms fully as you reach downward, while pivoting your feet towards your left side.
In a controlled motion, bring the dumbbell back up to the starting position, reversing the diagonal path.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Rotate your torso and pivot your feet to allow for a full range of motion.
Maintain a firm grip on the dumbbell to ensure control.
Perform the movement in a controlled manner to avoid swinging the dumbbell.
ex_ON5PGC.description: Dumbbell Diagonal Chop is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

ex_IFFQOU.name: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and feet stacked. Place your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell against your top hip with your upper hand.
Press your forearm into the floor and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Keep your shoulders and hips stacked while holding the dumbbell securely against your hip.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then lower your hips with control and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Maintain a straight line from your head to your feet without letting your hips drop.
Keep your shoulders and hips stacked without rotating forward or backward.
Engage your obliques and glutes to keep your pelvis lifted.
Inhale and exhale steadily throughout the hold without holding your breath.
ex_IFFQOU.description: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes, Forearms.

ex_ODJJAD.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Begin in a half-kneeling position with your left foot forward and your right knee on the floor. Hold one dumbbell with both hands low beside your right hip.
Rotate your torso to the left and lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body.
Continue raising the dumbbell until your arms extend above your left shoulder.
Reverse the movement and lower the dumbbell back toward your right hip, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your front foot flat on the floor and right knee directly below your hip for stability.
Rotate through your torso while keeping your hips and lower body stable.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and avoid pulling the dumbbell with your biceps.
Exhale as you lift and rotate the dumbbell, and inhale as you lower it.
ex_ODJJAD.description: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_3GGNGU.name: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your feet stacked. Place your supporting hand directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell securely against your top hip.
Press through your supporting palm and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Keep your supporting arm straight and maintain your shoulders and hips stacked while holding the position.
Hold for the desired duration, then repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Place your supporting hand directly below your shoulder and spread your fingers for stability.
Keep your feet stacked and avoid rotating your hips forward or backward.
Engage your obliques and glutes to prevent your hips from dropping.
Inhale and exhale steadily throughout the hold.
ex_3GGNGU.description: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps, Glutes.

ex_UQDQKM.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Kneel upright on both knees with your knees hip width apart and hold one dumbbell with both hands low beside one hip.
Rotate your torso and lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body until it is above the opposite shoulder, keeping your arms slightly bent.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your hips facing forward and your core engaged.
Reverse the movement and lower the dumbbell along the same diagonal path, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Rotate through your torso while keeping your hips stable and facing forward.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows without pulling the dumbbell with your arms alone.
Avoid leaning backward as the dumbbell reaches the top position.
Exhale as you lift and rotate the dumbbell, and inhale as you lower it.
ex_UQDQKM.description: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_LZLGGE.name: Dumbbell Overhead Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell horizontally above your head with both hands, keeping your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and slowly bend your torso to one side while keeping your hips still and your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly at a comfortable range while keeping the dumbbell steady overhead.
Contract your obliques to return to the upright position with control, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine without leaning forward, leaning backward, or twisting.
Keep the dumbbell aligned above your head as your torso bends sideways.
Bend only as far as you can while maintaining balance and control.
Inhale as you bend to the side and exhale as you return upright.
ex_LZLGGE.description: Dumbbell Overhead Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps, Core.

ex_5UOPHK.name: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your feet stacked. Place your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell securely against your top hip.
Press your forearm into the floor and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Slowly lower your hips toward the floor while keeping your shoulders and hips stacked.
Contract the side of your core to raise your hips back to the starting position, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder.
Lower your hips without allowing them to rotate forward or backward.
Raise your hips until your body forms a straight line without overextending.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you raise them.
ex_5UOPHK.description: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes, Forearms.

ex_F6YIPW.name: Dumbbell Suitcase Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended vertically and your feet together. Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest and extend your arms toward your legs.
Engage your core and lift your head, shoulders, and upper back while reaching the dumbbell toward your feet.
Pause briefly at the top and contract your abdominal muscles while keeping your legs raised and still.
Slowly lower your upper back toward the floor while maintaining the vertical leg position, then repeat.
tips: Keep your arms extended and the dumbbell securely held with both hands.
Keep your lower back controlled against the floor as you lower your torso.
Avoid swinging your arms or using momentum to complete the crunch.
Exhale as you crunch upward and inhale as you lower your upper body.
ex_F6YIPW.description: Dumbbell Suitcase Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques, Shoulders.

ex_JZA54A.name: Flat Knee Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Place your hands lightly behind your head, and rest your head and shoulders against the floor.
Engage your core and lift both feet together, drawing your knees toward your chest while maintaining the bend in your legs.
Continue raising your knees until they are positioned above your abdomen, gently tilting your pelvis toward your ribs without lifting your upper back.
Slowly lower both legs until your feet return to the floor, maintaining control throughout the descent, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Support your head lightly without pulling on your neck with your hands.
Draw both knees upward together without swinging or using momentum.
Lower your feet slowly and touch the floor lightly before beginning the next repetition.
Exhale as you draw your knees toward your chest and inhale as you lower your feet.
ex_JZA54A.description: Flat Knee Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_DJSZGH.name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms at your sides, palms facing down. Place your hands under your hips for added support if needed.
Lift your legs off the floor a few inches, keeping them straight and close together.
Quickly alternate kicking your legs up and down in a small, controlled motion, engaging your core throughout the movement.
Continue the flutter kicks for the desired duration, maintaining a steady and controlled pace. Lower your legs back to the floor to complete the exercise.
tips: Move your legs in a controlled manner to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you kick your legs and inhaling as you maintain the movement.
Avoid letting your lower back arch off the floor; keep it pressed down to prevent strain.
Adjust the height of your kicks to suit your fitness level and comfort, starting with smaller kicks and increasing the range of motion as you build strength.
ex_DJSZGH.description: Flutter Kicks is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_RNWUMP.name: Hanging Leg Raises
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, your arms straight, and your legs together.
Engage your core and raise both straight legs forward.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the floor.
Lower your legs with control to the hanging position, then repeat.
tips: Raise your legs without swinging your body.
Lower your legs slowly instead of letting them drop.
Keep your neck relaxed and look straight ahead.
Exhale as you raise your legs and inhale as you lower them.
ex_RNWUMP.description: Hanging Leg Raises is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps, Middle Back.

ex_YL3MEF.name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Brace your core and raise both knees up and across toward one shoulder.
Pause at the top, feeling the side of your waist contract.
Lower your legs with control without swinging, then repeat toward the other side.
tips: Pull your shoulders down away from your ears to protect them.
Move slowly; momentum takes the work away from your obliques.
ex_YL3MEF.description: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Forearms.

ex_42AAB2.name: Heel Touches
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Position your arms along your sides with your palms facing down.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor, engaging your core and keeping your neck relaxed.
Reach your right hand towards your right heel, bending your torso to the side. Return to the center and then reach your left hand towards your left heel.
Alternate sides in a controlled manner, maintaining the contraction in your core throughout the exercise. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move slowly and with control to maximize the effectiveness of the exercise and prevent injury.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you reach towards your heel and inhaling as you return to the center.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to prevent strain.
ex_42AAB2.description: Heel Touches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_X3EA24.name: High Cable Kneeling Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a high pulley on a cable machine. Kneel down facing the machine, holding the rope handles with both hands, and position them close to your head.
Keep your back straight and engage your core muscles to pull the rope down by crunching your torso towards your knees, bringing your elbows towards your thighs.
Just before your elbows touch your thighs, return to the starting position with control, keeping the tension on the cable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees are firmly planted on the floor for stability.
Keep your hips stable and avoid using momentum.
Exhale as you crunch down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
ex_X3EA24.description: High Cable Kneeling Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_BHFQ5T.name: High Knee Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms raised to shoulder height in front of you, palms facing down.
Lift your right knee towards your left elbow while simultaneously twisting your torso to the right, engaging your core.
Return to the starting position, then lift your left knee towards your right elbow while twisting your torso to the left.
Alternate sides in a controlled manner, maintaining a steady rhythm. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Twist your torso and lift your knee simultaneously to engage both your abs and obliques.
Move smoothly and with control to avoid straining your back or hips.
Ensure your movements are balanced and controlled to prevent injury.
ex_BHFQ5T.description: High Knee Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_NYPFMG.name: High Resistance Band Kneeling Crunch
