instructions: Attach a resistance band to a high anchor point. Kneel down facing the anchor point, holding the handles of the resistance band with both hands, bend your arms at 90 degrees to bring your hands close to your face, palms facing each other.
Pull the resistance band down by crunching your torso towards your knees, bringing your elbows towards your thighs.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, keeping the tension on the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees are firmly planted on the floor for stability.
Keep your hips stable and avoid using momentum.
Exhale as you crunch down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
ex_NYPFMG.description: High Resistance Band Kneeling Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_OZNUXM.name: Medicine Ball Hold the World
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly on the floor. Hold a medicine ball above the center of your chest with both hands and your elbows bent.
Press the medicine ball straight upward until your arms are extended above your chest.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping the ball steady.
Bend your elbows and lower the ball toward your chest with control, then repeat.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
Press the ball straight upward without moving it toward your head.
Avoid bouncing the ball against your chest.
Inhale as you lower the ball and exhale as you press it upward.
ex_OZNUXM.description: Medicine Ball Hold the World is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Forearms.

ex_PU7NAK.name: Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms stretched overhead.
Engage your core and lift your shoulders and legs off the floor, keeping your lower back pressed into the floor. Your body should form a slight curve with your arms and legs elevated.
Hold this position, maintaining tension in your core and keeping your lower back flat against the floor.
Continue to hold the position for the desired duration, then slowly lower your shoulders and legs back to the starting position.
tips: Ensure your shoulders and legs are lifted at the same height to create a balanced position.
Focus on steady breathing, inhaling through your nose and exhaling through your mouth to help maintain focus and endurance.
If the full hollow hold is too challenging, you can modify the position by bending your knees or keeping your arms by your sides.
Avoid straining your neck; keep it relaxed and in line with your spine.
ex_PU7NAK.description: Hollow Hold is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_CHGQYT.name: Jack Knives
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms stretched on your sides.
Simultaneously lift your upper body and legs towards each other, reaching your hands towards your feet. Engage your core to lift both your torso and legs.
Try to touch your hands to your feet at the top of the movement, forming a "V" shape with your body.
Slowly lower your upper body and legs back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: If the full movement is too challenging, modify by bending your knees slightly.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you lift your body and inhaling as you lower it.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor during the movement to prevent strain.
ex_CHGQYT.description: Jack Knives is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_NVHBHM.name: L Sit Hold
instructions: Place your hands on parallel bars, dip handles or the floor next to your hips.
Press down to lift your body, locking your elbows and pushing your shoulders down.
Raise your straight legs in front of you until they are parallel to the floor, forming an L shape.
Hold the position for the set time while breathing steadily, then lower with control.
tips: Point your toes and squeeze your thighs together to keep your legs straight.
Bend your knees (tuck sit) if you can't yet hold straight legs.
ex_NVHBHM.description: L Sit Hold is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

ex_AC3KCU.name: Landmine Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with the landmine bar beside you and hold the end of the bar above your chest with both hands.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and straight legs off the ground.
Keep your arms extended, holding the bar steady over your chest in the hollow position.
Hold for the set time while breathing steadily, then lower your legs and shoulders with control.
tips: Your lower back must stay flat on the floor; raise your legs higher if it arches.
Keep your chin slightly tucked.
ex_AC3KCU.description: Landmine Hollow Hold is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_BVWGMJ.name: Landmine Kneeling Twist
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar at chest height with both hands, arms extended.
Brace your core and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to bring the bar down in an arc toward one hip.
Return through the centre with control and continue to the other side.
tips: Let the movement come from your torso, not your arms.
Keep your glutes tight so your hips stay square.
ex_BVWGMJ.description: Landmine Kneeling Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders.

ex_CTP7EX.name: Landmine Oblique Twist
instructions: Stand facing the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the end of the bar at chest height with both hands.
Extend your arms and brace your core.
Rotate your torso and pivot your back foot to swing the bar in an arc down toward one hip.
Bring the bar back over the top with control and repeat to the other side.
tips: Keep your arms long and the movement smooth.
Pivot your feet so your lower back doesn't twist under load.
ex_CTP7EX.description: Landmine Oblique Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_DDNKI5.name: Landmine Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor beside the landmine with your knees bent and heels on the ground.
Hold the end of the bar with both hands above your chest and lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to lower the bar toward the floor on one side.
Bring it back over the top with control and lower it to the other side.
tips: Keep your chest open; don't round your back.
Lift your feet off the floor to make it harder.
ex_DDNKI5.description: Landmine Russian Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_VNUHFB.name: Leg Lift Circles
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms at your sides, palms facing down.
Lift both legs off the floor, about a foot above the floor, keeping your legs straight and your core engaged.
Begin to draw small circles in the air with both legs moving together in a controlled and steady motion. Perform the circles in one direction for a set number of repetitions.
Switch directions and draw circles with both legs in the opposite direction for the same number of repetitions. Lower your legs back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your legs as straight as possible to maximize the stretch and engagement in your hip flexors and quadriceps.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to prevent discomfort or injury.
If you find it difficult to keep your legs straight, you can start with smaller circles and gradually increase the size as you build strength and flexibility.
ex_VNUHFB.description: Leg Lift Circles is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Abductors.

ex_UNKXLU.name: Long Arm Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Extend your arms straight in line with your head, keeping them close to your ears, and hands crossed over each other.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the floor, with your arms following your torso line, until it forms a 45-degree angle with the floor.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Slowly lower your body back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms straight and aligned with your ears to ensure proper form and avoid straining your neck.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor throughout the exercise to prevent lower back strain.
Use a comfortable, non-slip exercise mat to provide cushioning and prevent slipping during the movement.
ex_UNKXLU.description: Long Arm Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_H2WPDY.name: Long Lever Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank, then walk your elbows forward so they are in front of your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core hard and squeeze your glutes.
Hold the position for the set time while breathing steadily.
tips: The further your elbows are in front, the harder it gets.
Don't let your hips sag or your lower back arch.
ex_H2WPDY.description: Long Lever Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_OFBH52.name: Lying Abs Resistance Band
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Attach the resistance band to a low anchor point behind your head and hold the handles with both hands, keeping your arms bent and handles close to your head.
Curl your upper body, bringing your elbows towards your knees while lifting your back off the floor.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you curl your torso up and inhale as you lower it back down.
Keep your feet flat on the floor for better stability.
Focus on engaging your abdominal muscles throughout the movement.
ex_OFBH52.description: Lying Abs Resistance Band is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_MDXEXU.name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms at your sides, palms facing down firm on the floor.
Engage your core muscles and press your lower back into the floor.
Keeping your legs straight, lift them up towards the ceiling until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control, stopping just before they touch the floor. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lift your legs up and inhale as you lower them back down.
Keep your legs as straight as possible for maximum effectiveness.
Focus on engaging your abdominal muscles throughout the movement.
ex_MDXEXU.description: Lying Leg Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_7PNKOC.name: Med Ball Half Kneeling Wood Choppers
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
Start with the ball beside your hip on the side of the down knee.
Rotate your torso and lift the ball diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Return along the same path with control, then switch sides after the set.
tips: Keep your hips facing forward and squeeze the glute of the down leg.
Move with control; let your torso, not your arms, do the work.
ex_7PNKOC.description: Med Ball Half Kneeling Wood Choppers is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_6NM7DK.name: Med Ball Toe Touches
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Hold a medicine ball with both hands above your chest, arms straight.
Curl your shoulders off the floor and reach the ball up toward your toes.
Lower your shoulders with control and repeat.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Exhale as you reach up.
ex_6NM7DK.description: Med Ball Toe Touches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_RUYIWG.name: Medicine Ball Chest Throw With Abs
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, facing a partner or a wall, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Curl up into a sit-up and, as you rise, throw the ball forcefully from your chest.
Catch the ball, or receive it back from your partner, at chest height.
Lower your back to the floor with control and repeat.
tips: Brace your core before each throw.
Use a ball you can throw with full speed and good form.
ex_RUYIWG.description: Medicine Ball Chest Throw With Abs is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Triceps, Shoulders.

ex_IA7P7Q.name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall about an arm's length away, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at your hip.
Load by rotating your torso away from the wall and bending your knees slightly.
Drive from your legs and hips and rotate explosively to throw the ball into the wall.
Catch the rebound, reset and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Pivot your back foot so the power comes from your hips.
Keep your arms relaxed; they guide the ball, the core throws it.
ex_IA7P7Q.description: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_HTSGFQ.name: Middle Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight on the floor and your arms straight by your sides, palms facing the floor.
Curl your abdomen, raising your upper back off the floor, while simultaneously lifting your legs straight up towards the ceiling and raise your arms towards your feet.
Just before your hands and feet touch, lower your upper back, legs and arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lift your upper back, legs and arms up, and inhale as you lower them back down.
Keep your legs as straight as possible for maximum abdominal activation.
Focus on engaging your abdominal muscles throughout the movement.
ex_HTSGFQ.description: Middle Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_7O4ZTL.name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Begin in a plank position on your toes and hands, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your right elbow and stop when your knee is close to the elbow.
Return to the starting plank position, then repeat the movement on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure you keep your movements smooth and controlled to maintain form and avoid injury.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the plank position.
Keep your shoulders stable and your core engaged throughout the exercise to enhance effectiveness.
ex_7O4ZTL.description: Mountain Climber is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_TDCPIF.name: Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands behind your head, keeping your elbows wide.
Engage your core muscles and lift your upper back off the floor, rotating your abdomen to raise your right elbow towards the ceiling.
Squeeze your obliques at the top of the movement and slowly lower your upper back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides to work the opposite oblique.
tips: Exhale as you lift and rotate your upper body, and inhale as you lower it back down.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; let your abs do the work.
Focus on engaging your oblique muscles throughout the movement.
ex_TDCPIF.description: Oblique Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_JFBYJX.name: Over Weight Ab Crunch
instructions: Begin by lying on your back with your legs straight on the floor close together. Hold a dumbbell with both hands, keeping your arms bent and behind your head, close to the floor.
Engage your core muscles and lift your torso off the floor while bending your knees and raising them to your chest, and bringing the dumbbell close to your knees.
Lower your body back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you crunch up and inhale as you lower back down.
Start with a lighter weight to master the form before progressing to heavier weights.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and avoid injury.
ex_JFBYJX.description: Over Weight Ab Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

ex_MHEGCQ.name: Plank Cross Knee Drive
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core.
Lift your right knee and drive it towards your left elbow and straighten your leg, twisting your torso slightly to the left as you do so.
Return your right leg to the starting plank position.
Repeat the movement with your left knee, driving it towards your right elbow. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you drive your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
ex_MHEGCQ.description: Plank Cross Knee Drive is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors.

ex_GFDI7B.name: Plank Jack
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core.
Jump your feet out to the sides, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, while keeping your upper body stable.
Quickly jump your feet back together to return to the starting plank position.
Continue jumping your feet in and out for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
tips: Move quickly but with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Maintain a neutral head position, looking slightly ahead of your hands, to keep your neck aligned with your spine.
Ensure your body stays in a straight line, avoiding sagging hips or raised buttocks.
ex_GFDI7B.description: Plank Jack is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_QYNTZL.name: Plank Knee Tucks
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Quickly jump both knees towards your chest, landing with both feet flat on the floor beneath you.
Immediately jump your feet back to the starting plank position.
Continue jumping your feet in and out for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use controlled, explosive movements to quickly bring your knees to your chest and return to plank position.
Ensure your shoulders remain directly over your wrists to maintain alignment and reduce strain on your shoulders.
Keep your hips level throughout the movement to maintain proper form and avoid sagging or raising your hips.
ex_QYNTZL.description: Plank Knee Tucks is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

ex_E3H73A.name: Plank Reach Through
instructions: Begin in a side plank position on your right side with your right elbow supporting your body, your left arm raised vertically towards the ceiling, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your left arm, reaching it under and across your torso while slightly lowering your hips.
Return your left arm to the starting position, lifting your hips back to the straight line.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left side and repeat the movement with your right arm.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Ensure your supporting arm or elbow is directly under your shoulder to maintain proper alignment and reduce strain.
Keep your hips stable and aligned with your body, avoiding excessive rotation.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you reach under your torso and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
ex_E3H73A.description: Plank Reach Through is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

ex_Z7CY5I.name: Plank on Elbows
instructions: Begin by lying face down on the floor. Place your elbows directly under your shoulders and your forearms flat on the floor, parallel to each other.
Engage your core and lift your body off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your heels. Your elbows and toes should support your body weight.
Hold this position, keeping your core tight and your body straight. Avoid letting your hips sag or rise too high.
Maintain the plank position for the desired amount of time, focusing on your form and breathing steadily.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, avoiding any sagging or lifting of the hips.
Keep your shoulders directly above your elbows to maintain proper alignment and reduce strain on your shoulders.
ex_Z7CY5I.description: Plank on Elbows is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Lower Back.

ex_KUKPQE.name: Plate Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back holding a weight plate with both hands, arms extended above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and straight legs off the ground.
Keep the plate steady above you in the hollow position.
Hold for the set time while breathing steadily, then lower with control.
tips: Raise your legs higher if your lower back starts to arch.
Keep your chin slightly tucked.
ex_KUKPQE.description: Plate Hollow Hold is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_LG2BFV.name: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
instructions: Stand tall and pinch a weight plate in one hand at your side, fingers on one face and thumb on the other.
Place the other hand on your hip or behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the plate as far as you comfortably can, keeping your hips still.
Return to upright by contracting the opposite side of your waist, then switch sides after the set.
tips: Bend straight to the side; don't lean forward or back.
The pinch grip also trains your fingers and forearm.
ex_LG2BFV.description: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Core.

ex_7UXE4F.name: Plate Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels on the ground, holding a weight plate at your chest.
Lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to bring the plate to one side of your hips.
Rotate back through the centre to the other side and repeat.
tips: Lift your feet to make it harder.
Turn your shoulders, not just your arms.
ex_7UXE4F.description: Plate Russian Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_BNC262.name: Plate Situp
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, holding a weight plate on your chest.
Brace your core and curl your torso up until you are sitting upright.
Pause at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control and repeat.
tips: Anchor your feet under something if they lift.
Don't pull with your neck; lead with your chest.
ex_BNC262.description: Plate Situp is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_6FUDH4.name: Plate Standing Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight plate at chest height with your arms slightly bent.
Brace your core and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return through the centre with control and rotate to the other side.
tips: Keep the movement controlled; don't swing the plate.
Extending your arms further makes it harder.
ex_6FUDH4.description: Plate Standing Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders.

ex_B5ODCW.name: Plate Wood Chopper
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width, holding a weight plate with both hands.
Start with the plate above one shoulder, arms extended.
Rotate and squat slightly as you bring the plate diagonally down across your body to the outside of the opposite knee.
Reverse the movement back up to the starting position, then switch sides after the set.
tips: Pivot your feet to protect your lower back.
Keep your back flat as you reach down.
ex_B5ODCW.description: Plate Wood Chopper is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

ex_4H45SN.name: Raised Leg Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight, vertical to the floor. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your core and lift your shoulders off the floor, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Lower your shoulders back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; instead, use your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Keep your lower back pressed against the floor to prevent strain and maintain proper form.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
ex_4H45SN.description: Raised Leg Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_V4PWLP.name: Reverse Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands on the floor, arms straight, and the ab roller set under your feet. Your legs should be straight back, forming a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and slowly roll the ab roller towards your hands, keeping your legs straight. Continue rolling until your thighs are vertical to the floor.
Hold the position briefly, ensuring your core is tight and your back is straight.
Roll the ab roller back to the starting position with control, maintaining a straight line with your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you roll the roller towards your hands and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Avoid arching your back; maintain a neutral spine to prevent strain on your lower back.
Start with a small range of motion if you are new to this exercise, gradually increasing the distance as you build strength.
Perform the exercise on a stable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and prevent slipping.
ex_V4PWLP.description: Reverse Ab Wheel Rollout is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Quadriceps.

ex_WBFNP4.name: Reverse Crunch With Kick Out
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your arms by your sides with palms facing down for stability.
Lift your legs off the floor, bending your knees at a 90-degree angle so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and your calves are parallel to the floor.
Extend your legs straight out in front of you, keeping them off the floor to perform a kick-out.

Bend your knees back to the starting position and engage your core to lift your hips off the floor, curling your knees towards your chest. Lower your hips back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum to lift your hips; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor to avoid straining your neck.
ex_WBFNP4.description: Reverse Crunch With Kick Out is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_T3DC5Q.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your arms by your sides with palms facing down for stability.
Lift your legs off the floor, bending your knees at a 90-degree angle so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and your calves are parallel to the floor.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, curling your knees towards your chest. Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your hips.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position, keeping your knees bent at a 90-degree angle. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum to lift your hips; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them back down.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor to avoid straining your neck.
ex_T3DC5Q.description: Reverse Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

ex_24SSHX.name: Reverse Plank
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your chest open.
Hold the position for the set time, then lower with control.
tips: Don't let your hips drop.
Keep your neck in line with your body; look up rather than letting your head hang back.
ex_24SSHX.description: Reverse Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Shoulders, Triceps.

ex_MW3HCH.name: Russian Twist With Medicine Ball
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels on the ground, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to bring the ball beside one hip.
Rotate back through the centre to the other side and repeat.
tips: Lift your feet to make it harder.
Keep your chest open and turn your shoulders.
ex_MW3HCH.description: Russian Twist With Medicine Ball is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_FMODK4.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Lean back slightly so that your torso forms a V-shape with your thighs.
Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing your hands opposite your right hip.
Rotate back through the center and to the left, bringing your hands opposite your left hip. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move your torso, not just your arms, to ensure you are engaging your oblique muscles.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you rotate to each side and inhaling as you return to the center.
Keep your back straight and avoid hunching your shoulders to maintain proper form.
ex_FMODK4.description: Russian Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

ex_QAMLER.name: Scissors Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Lift both legs off the floor a few inches, keeping them straight.
Alternately cross your legs over each other in a scissor-like motion. Move your right leg over your left leg and then switch, bringing your left leg over your right leg.
Continue alternating legs in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
tips: Ensure your lower back remains pressed against the floor to avoid strain and maintain proper form.
Move your legs slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
Avoid letting your legs drop too low, which could increase strain on your lower back.
ex_QAMLER.description: Scissors Kick is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

ex_YZSV7L.name: Seated Flutter Kicks
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs extended straight out in front of you. Lean back slightly, supporting yourself by gripping the sides of the bench.
Lift both legs off the bench a few inches, keeping them straight.
Begin the flutter kicks by alternately raising and lowering your legs in a scissor-like motion, moving your right leg up while your left leg moves down and vice versa.
Continue the flutter kicks for the desired number of repetitions or duration, keeping your core engaged and your movements controlled.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders to maintain proper form.
Perform the exercise on a stable, non-slip bench to ensure safety and prevent slipping.
If you are new to this exercise, start with a smaller range of motion and gradually increase it as you build strength.
ex_YZSV7L.description: Seated Flutter Kicks is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_YHSZPM.name: Seated V Up
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your arms placed on the floor slightly behind you for support.
Engage your core and lift your torso off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest to form a V shape with your body.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Lower your legs and torso back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift into the V position and inhaling as you lower back down.
Avoid using momentum to lift your legs and torso; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders to maintain proper form.
ex_YHSZPM.description: Seated V Up is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_23A7N6.name: Side Plank Oblique Crunch
instructions: Begin in a side plank position on your right side, with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder. Place your left hand on your hip.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your feet.
Lower your hips towards the floor without touching it, then raise them back up to the starting position, squeezing your obliques at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other side and perform the exercise on your left side.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain balance and stability.
Move your hips slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them.
ex_23A7N6.description: Side Plank Oblique Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders.

ex_JDVEAS.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your right side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold the position for the desired duration, keeping your body straight and your core tight.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat on the other side by lying on your left side and following the same steps.
tips: Ensure your elbow is directly under your shoulder to support your upper body.
Focus on keeping your head in line with your spine to prevent neck strain.
Maintain a straight body line, avoiding any sagging or lifting of the hips.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort.
ex_JDVEAS.description: Side Plank is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

ex_WNX55S.name: Spider Plank
instructions: Begin in a standard plank position with your forearms on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core and keep your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right foot off the floor and bring your right knee towards your right elbow, keeping your hips level and your core tight.
Return your right foot to the starting position, maintaining a stable plank position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, bringing your left knee towards your left elbow. Continue alternating legs for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Focus on keeping your hips level and avoiding excessive torso rotation.
Use a mat to cushion your forearms and feet for added comfort.
ex_WNX55S.description: Spider Plank is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes, Hip Flexors.

ex_FT67MM.name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an ab wheel with both hands. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
Bend at your hips and knees to lower the ab wheel to the floor in front of your feet. Keep your arms extended and your back straight.
Slowly roll the ab wheel forward, extending your body into a plank position. Ensure your core remains tight and your back stays straight throughout the movement.
Roll the ab wheel back towards your feet, bending at your hips and knees to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you roll out and inhaling as you return.
Keep your back straight and avoid sagging or arching your lower back.
ex_FT67MM.description: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Back, Hip Flexors.

ex_QC3MCL.name: Standing Cable Oblique Twist
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a handle to a mid-pulley and grasp it with both hands. Bend your arms at 90 degrees and keep your elbows close to your torso sides.
Engage your core and keep your arms stationary as you twist your torso away from the machine, pulling the handle across your body.
Twist until your shoulders are turned 90 degrees from the machine, feeling the stretch in your oblique muscles.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, keeping your arms straight. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Use your oblique muscles to twist, not your arms, hips, or legs.
Keep your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Adjust the cable machine weight to a challenging but manageable level.
ex_QC3MCL.description: Standing Cable Oblique Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Lower Back, Glutes.

ex_WBQSTK.name: Standing Oblique Crunch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, placing your hands behind your head with your elbows flared out to the sides. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
Lift your right knee towards your right elbow while simultaneously bending your torso to the right to bring your elbow and knee closer together.
Return to the starting position by lowering your right leg and straightening your torso.
Repeat the movement on the left side, lifting your left knee towards your left elbow. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you crunch to the side and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Ensure your standing leg remains slightly bent to maintain balance.
Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward or backward during the exercise.
ex_WBQSTK.description: Standing Oblique Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_SL2PUV.name: Star Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms and legs extended out to form an "X" shape. Keep your core engaged and your lower back pressed into the floor.
Crunch your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders and legs off the floor and lift your arms and legs towards each other, reaching your hands towards your ankles.
Lower your arms and legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your arm and leg, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your arms and legs off the floor.
Use a mat to provide cushioning and support for your back.
ex_SL2PUV.description: Star Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

ex_IJ5DFK.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Abdominal Fallout
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about waist height. Stand in front of the hanging handles with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the handles with your palms facing down.
Engage your core and lean forward, allowing your arms to extend overhead while maintaining a straight body line from head to heels.
Lower your body until your arms are fully extended above your head, feeling the tension in your core.
Pull your body back to the starting position by pulling your arms back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lean forward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Adjust the length of the suspension trainer straps to increase or decrease the difficulty of the exercise.
Keep your arms straight and avoid bending your elbows during the movement.
ex_IJ5DFK.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Abdominal Fallout is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Chest, Shoulders.

ex_Q4OMPR.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hanging Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to an overhead position. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip (palms facing forward) and hang with your arms fully extended and feet off the floor.
Engage your core and lift your knees up towards the ceiling to hip height, then pull your hips up to raise your legs to chest height.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control, keeping your core engaged.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a controlled motion to prevent swinging.
Focus on using your core muscles to lift your legs and hips, avoiding excessive use of your hip flexors.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your legs and inhale as you lower them.
ex_Q4OMPR.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hanging Leg Hip Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back, Forearms.

ex_C3LBVJ.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hanging Straight Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to an overhead position. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip (palms facing forward) and hang with your arms fully extended and feet off the floor.
Engage your core and lift your legs straight up towards the ceiling, aiming to bring your hips up as well.
Raise your legs until your body forms a V-shape, keeping them straight throughout the movement.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a controlled motion to prevent swinging.
Focus on using your core muscles to lift your legs and hips, avoiding excessive use of your hip flexors.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your legs and inhale as you lower them.
ex_C3LBVJ.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hanging Straight Leg Hip Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back, Forearms.

ex_7QBT6M.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Pull Through
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Sit on the floor with your legs extended and place your feet in the handles. Position your hands on the floor by your sides, fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and press through your hands to lift your hips off the floor, coming into a reverse plank position. Your body should form a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your hips towards the floor with control, keeping your legs and arms straight. Stop just before your hips touch the floor.
Press through your hands and lift your hips to the reverse plank position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core tight to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement with a steady and controlled tempo to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
ex_7QBT6M.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Pull Through is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Forearms.

ex_VHG4JE.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Reverse Ab Rollout
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Place your feet in the handles and assume a plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, placed directly under your shoulders, arms slightly bent, and body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and bend your knees to bring them towards your chest while lifting your hips upwards, creating a V position.
Continue bringing your knees towards your chest until your hips are fully bent and your knees are close to your chest.
Slowly extend your legs back to the starting plank position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you bring your knees towards your chest and inhale as you extend your legs back.
Start with a smaller range of motion and gradually increase as your strength and flexibility improve.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging them towards your ears.
ex_VHG4JE.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Reverse Ab Rollout is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

ex_RLQUSD.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Supine Crunch
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Sit on your hips with your heels in the handles and legs extended straight, and place your arms by your sides for support.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor while keeping your legs straight.
Curl your knees towards your chest, and stop just before your knees touch your chest.
Slowly bring your legs back to starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core tight to maximize muscle engagement and prevent your back from arching
Start with a smaller range of motion and gradually increase as your strength improves.
Incorporate this exercise into your routine for a comprehensive core workout.
ex_RLQUSD.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Supine Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_E3IZHT.name: V Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms extended on the floor overhead.
Simultaneously lift your legs and torso off the floor, reaching your hands towards your feet to form a 'V' shape with your body.
Squeeze your abdominal muscles at the top of the movement, ensuring your hands reach towards your feet.
Slowly lower your legs and torso back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift into the 'V' position and inhale as you lower back down.
Avoid using momentum to lift your legs and torso; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your legs and arms straight throughout the movement for maximum effectiveness.
ex_E3IZHT.description: V Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

ex_2FEEZD.name: Walkout
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed by your sides.
Bend your hips and knees to place your hands on the floor before you.
Walk your hands forward, keeping your legs straight, until you are in a plank position with your hands under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Walk your hands back towards your feet, lifting your hips and forming an inverted V shape with your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid letting your hips sag or rise too high when in the plank position.
Keep your legs as straight as possible while walking your hands to and from the plank position.
Use a mat to provide cushioning for your hands and prevent slipping.
ex_2FEEZD.description: Walkout is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings, Glutes.

ex_RIBC53.name: Wheels to Heaven
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight together, and your arms resting by your sides. Position an ab roller between your heels.
Lift your legs up towards the ceiling, keeping them slightly bent, holding the ab roller securely between your heels.
Engage your core and push your legs upward, raising your hips high off the floor.
Lower your hips back down slowly keeping your legs up. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Start with a smaller range of motion if you are new to the exercise and gradually increase it as you gain strength.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your legs and hips, and inhale as you lower them back down.
Avoid using momentum to lift your hips; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
ex_RIBC53.description: Wheels to Heaven is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_QHIARP.name: Wheels to Toes
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight together and your arms extended diagonally overhead, holding an ab roller.
Lift your legs up towards the ceiling, keeping them straight, and simultaneously raise the ab roller towards your toes, lifting your upper back off the floor.
Slowly lower your legs and the ab roller back down to the starting position, stopping just before they touch the floor.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort.
Ensure your lower back stays in contact with the floor when your legs are lowered.
Start with a smaller range of motion if you are new to the exercise and gradually increase it as you gain strength.
ex_QHIARP.description: Wheels to Toes is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

ex_NQHWQL.name: Wind Wipers
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides for stability, lift your legs up towards the ceiling, and keep them bent at 90 degrees.
Lower your knees to the right side, keeping them bent together until they are just above the floor.
Raise your knees back to the center position, and then lower them to the left side until they are just above the floor.
Repeat the movement, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions.

ex_ZD5VW7.name: Dumbbell Alternating Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand. Bend your knees and hinge forward at your hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, allowing both arms to hang straight beneath your shoulders, resting the dumbbells on the floor.
Pull one dumbbell toward your abdomen by driving your elbow upward close to your body, while keeping the opposite arm extended.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control until your arm is fully extended.

ex_HJMNWQ.name: Dumbbell Goblet Good Morning
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands. Keep your knees slightly bent and your core engaged.

ex_QACT6Y.name: Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row
instructions: Begin in a wide stance with one foot pointing forward and the other pointing to the side. Bend your knees, lean forward, brace your free hand on your thigh, and hold the dumbbell between your legs with an overhand grip.

ex_OOQX3W.name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand using a neutral grip. Bend your knees and hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, with the dumbbells hanging below your shoulders.

ex_LNM7O6.name: Dumbbell Bent Over Row (Pronated Grip)

ex_PTCY7S.name: Dumbbells Plank to Alternating Row
instructions: Begin in a high plank position with your hands gripping a dumbbell each on the floor, directly under your shoulders, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Your feet should be slightly wider than hip-width apart for stability.
