When the barbell is behind your head, reverse the movement by extending your elbows to return the barbell to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then carefully rack the barbell back onto the bench press rack.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms to isolate the triceps.
Lower the barbell slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Ensure a firm grip on the barbell to maintain control and proper alignment throughout the movement.
ex_4C7SNB.description: Barbell Lying Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

ex_WUHPGJ.name: Barbell Lying Triceps Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart. Your arms should be fully extended above your chest.
Slowly lower the barbell by bending your elbows, bringing the barbell towards your forehead.
When the barbell is just above your forehead, reverse the movement by extending your elbows to return the barbell to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then carefully rack the barbell back onto the bench press rack.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms to isolate the triceps.
Lower the barbell slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Ensure a firm grip on the barbell to maintain control and proper alignment throughout the movement.
ex_WUHPGJ.description: Barbell Lying Triceps Skull Crusher is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

ex_YFHTH3.name: Cable Cross Pushdown
instructions: Stand upright between two high cable pulleys and hold each handle in the opposite hand.Bend your elbows so that the handles are crossing in front of your chest.
Extend your elbows to press the handles down and outward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly while squeezing your triceps at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly bend your elbows to return the handles to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your sides throughout the exercise.
Move only at your elbows and avoid swinging your shoulders.
Keep your torso upright and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Inhale as you return to the starting position and exhale as you press the handles downward.
ex_YFHTH3.description: Cable Cross Pushdown is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms, Core.

ex_WEYEDR.name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly planted and hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest using a neutral grip.
Keep your upper arms fixed, then bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Extend your elbows to raise the dumbbells along the same path until your arms are straight.
Repeat for the required amount of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing upward instead of allowing them to flare outward.
Maintain contact between your head, upper back, hips, and the bench.
Hold your upper arms steady and move only through your elbows.
Inhale as you lower the dumbbells and exhale as you extend your elbows.
ex_WEYEDR.description: Dumbbell Skullcrusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms, Chest.

ex_EPEYKW.name: Floor Tricep Dip
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your heels planted in front of you with your toes pointing upward. Place both hands behind your hips with your palms flat, your fingers pointing toward your feet, and your elbows slightly bent.
Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips slightly above the floor, keeping your chest raised and your shoulders pulled back.
Press firmly through your palms and extend your elbows to lift your hips. Pause at the top, while squeezing your triceps.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips, returning to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Point your elbows backward instead of allowing them to flare outward.
Move through your elbows rather than dropping and raising your hips alone.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging them toward your ears.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you press upward.
ex_EPEYKW.description: Floor Tricep Dip is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest, Forearms.

ex_OFMXLA.name: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Lift your hips and hold a kettlebell above your chest with both hands using a neutral grip.
Keep your hips raised as you bend your elbows and lower the kettlebell toward your forehead, stopping just above it with control.
Extend your elbows and raise the kettlebell back above your chest.
Repeat the movement while maintaining the bridge position, for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain your hips in a raised and level position.
Keep your elbows close together as you lower the weight.
Avoid arching your lower back as you hold the bridge.
Inhale as you lower the kettlebell and exhale as you extend your elbows.
ex_OFMXLA.description: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms, Glutes.

ex_C2OFTR.name: Kettlebell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with straight arms.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the kettlebell toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows to return and repeat.
tips: Point your elbows to the ceiling.
Lower slowly.
ex_C2OFTR.description: Kettlebell Skull Crusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category.

ex_RO6P6V.name: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the horns overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the kettlebell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to lift it back up and repeat.
tips: Brace your core to avoid arching your back.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
ex_RO6P6V.description: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

ex_A4FVZ3.name: Landmine Lying Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near the landmine and hold the end of the bar above your face with both hands.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to press it back up and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing up.
Control the lowering.
ex_A4FVZ3.description: Landmine Lying Tricep Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category.

ex_NSCLHW.name: Plate Curl to Overhead Press to Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Curl it up to your chest, then press it overhead.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, then extend your arms.
Lower the plate back to your chest and thighs and repeat.
tips: Do each phase under control.
Keep your core braced overhead.
ex_NSCLHW.description: Plate Curl to Overhead Press to Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Forearms.

ex_USQTD2.name: Plate Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand or sit holding a weight plate overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms by your ears.
Lower the plate behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to return and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Brace your core.
ex_USQTD2.description: Plate Overhead Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

ex_WDW5LF.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Triceps Extension
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about waist height. Stand facing the handles, holding the handles with an overhand grip (palms facing down), and lean forward slightly with your upper arms perpendicular to your torso.
Keep your arms bent at 90 degrees. Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Extend your arms by pressing through your hands until your elbows are fully straight.
Slowly bend your elbows to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you bend your elbows.
Focus on using your triceps to perform the extension, avoiding excessive use of your chest, shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and avoid flaring them out to the sides.
ex_WDW5LF.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Triceps Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

ex_ROHF2U.name: Tricep Cable Kickback on Crossover Machine
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, and set the cable at a low position. Hold the cable end in one hand and bend slightly forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Position your upper arm parallel to the floor with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Extend your arm backward by straightening your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary, and only moving your forearm.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbow. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
tips: Focus on using your triceps to perform the extension, avoiding excessive use of your shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arm stationary throughout the exercise to ensure proper form.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain control and proper form throughout the exercise.
ex_ROHF2U.description: Tricep Cable Kickback on Crossover Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms.

ex_VO5ZFH.name: Tricep Extension Machine
instructions: Sit on the tricep extension machine, adjusting the seat height so that your upper arms comfortably rest on the arm pad, with your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Grasp the handles with a neutral grip, ensuring your elbows are below the pivot point.
Push the handles forward by straightening your elbows and fully extending your arms while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbows. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Focus on using your triceps to push the handles, avoiding excessive use of your shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arms stationary on the pad to ensure proper form.
ex_VO5ZFH.description: Tricep Extension Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

ex_ORJDSH.name: Tricep Rope Extension on Crossover Machine
instructions: Attach a rope to a high cable and hold the ends with your palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the rope down until your arms are straight, separating the ends at the bottom.
Return slowly to about 90 degrees at the elbow and repeat.
tips: Only your forearms move.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
ex_ORJDSH.description: Tricep Rope Extension on Crossover Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category.

ex_V36EQ3.name: 3 Leg Chaturanga Pose
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands shoulder-width apart and feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right leg straight back and up, keeping your hips level.
Shift your body forward into a plank position while keeping the right leg lifted.
Lower your body towards the floor by bending your elbows close to your sides, maintaining a straight line from head to left heel. Return to the plank position and repeat on the left side.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the movement.
Keep your elbows close to your body to protect your shoulders.
Breathe steadily, inhaling as you lower and exhaling as you push back up.
ex_V36EQ3.description: 3 Leg Chaturanga Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Obliques, Glutes.

ex_3U5INF.name: 3 Leg Dog Pose
instructions: Start in a downward-facing dog position with your hands shoulder-width apart and feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right leg straight back and up, keeping your hips level and ensuring your body forms a straight line from your wrists to your raised foot.
Hold the position, keeping your core engaged and your leg extended.
Lower your right leg back to the floor and return to the plank position. Repeat with the left leg.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the movement.
Keep your hips squared to the floor to ensure proper alignment.
Breathe steadily, inhaling as you lift your leg and exhaling as you lower it.
ex_3U5INF.description: 3 Leg Dog Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Core.

ex_BVY2OQ.name: Ab Wheel Plank
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward until your body is in a plank position, with your arms extended and your body forming a straight line from head to knees.
Hold the plank position, keeping your core engaged and your body stable, as long as required.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your spine neutral and avoid letting your lower back sag. This helps protect your spine and ensures proper form.
Focus on engaging your entire core, including your abdominals, obliques, and lower back, to maintain stability.
Roll out and back in with controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and minimize the risk of injury.
ex_BVY2OQ.description: Ab Wheel Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

ex_CO3RAX.name: Alternate Sprinter Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Lunge back with your right leg, bending both knees to lower your body into a lunge position while reaching your hands towards your left foot.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Lunge back with your left leg, reaching your hands towards your right foot. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
ex_CO3RAX.description: Alternate Sprinter Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Calves.

ex_U5A5ZP.name: Alternating Leg Downward Dog
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with your hands and feet on the mat, hips lifted towards the ceiling, and body forming an inverted V shape.
Bend your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot on the floor and maintaining balance on your left foot and both hands.
Straighten your right leg back to the starting position.
Bend your left knee towards your chest while maintaining balance. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and balance throughout the exercise.
Focus on keeping your hips squared and aligned with the mat to avoid twisting your body.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
ex_U5A5ZP.description: Alternating Leg Downward Dog is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Core.

ex_I76VBM.name: Archer Stepback
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight and feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms forward while keeping your palms inward.
Take a step backward by extending your left leg behind you while taking your elbow past your back like an archer.
Hold for a while, return to the initial position, and repeat by taking your right leg backward.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Ensure your front knee is aligned with your ankle and does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement with controlled motions to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
ex_I76VBM.description: Archer Stepback is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

ex_VZSOGV.name: Bow Pose
instructions: Lie face down with your legs stretched back and your arms extended in front of you, palms facing down.
Bend your knees and reach back to grasp your ankles with your hands.
Lift your chest and thighs off the floor by pressing your legs into your hands until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then slowly lower your body and release your ankles.
tips: Engage your core to help stabilize your spine.
Avoid forcing the stretch beyond a comfortable range of motion.
Lift your chest by pressing your legs into your hands rather than pulling with your arms.
Breathe slowly and evenly while holding the stretch.
ex_VZSOGV.description: Bow Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Chest, Hip Flexors.

ex_75XC2N.name: Cat Pose
instructions: Begin on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. Keep your arms straight and your gaze toward the floor.
Slowly round your back toward the ceiling by tucking your chin toward your chest and drawing your tailbone underneath you.
Hold the stretched position briefly while keeping your shoulders relaxed and your core gently engaged.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hands directly beneath your shoulders and your knees beneath your hips.
Draw your belly button inward to help deepen the spinal movement.
Round your spine evenly from your neck to your lower back.
Inhale in the starting position and exhale as you round your back.
ex_75XC2N.description: Cat Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Upper Back, Shoulders.

ex_BWKQ2C.name: Chair Pose
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and raise both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat while keeping your chest lifted and your arms extended overhead.
Hold the position while keeping your heels on the floor, and your weight evenly distributed across both feet.
Press through your heels to return to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Sit your hips back as if lowering onto a chair.
Keep your knees aligned with your toes without allowing them to collapse inward.
Engage your core to improve balance and stability.
Inhale as you lower into the pose and exhale as you return to standing.
ex_BWKQ2C.description: Chair Pose is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

ex_DPBTEK.name: Child Pose Arms Extended Left Right
instructions: Begin in a kneeling position with your hips resting on your heels, face forward with your hands to your sides.
Lower your torso toward the floor and slowly extend both hands to one side while keeping your hips resting on your heels, resting your forehead on your hands.
Hold the stretch when you feel it along the side of your upper back and torso.
Return your to your starting position, repeat the stretch to the opposite side, and continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your hips resting on your heels throughout the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging them toward your ears
Stretch only until you feel a comfortable pull along your side.
Inhale in the center and exhale as you reach to each side.
ex_DPBTEK.description: Child Pose Arms Extended Left Right is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Shoulders, Lower Back.

ex_TWNTLJ.name: Child Pose Arms on Side
instructions: Begin in a tall kneeling position with your knees slightly apart and your hands resting by your sides.
Sit your hips back onto your heels as you lower your chest toward your thighs, allowing your forehead to rest on the floor.
Extend your arms alongside your body with your palms facing upward and relax your shoulders.
Hold the stretch, then slowly return to the starting position with control.
tips: Keep your hips resting on your heels throughout the stretch.
Allow your shoulders to relax completely as your arms rest beside your body.
Avoid lifting your hips away from your heels.
Inhale deeply and exhale as you settle further into the stretch.
ex_TWNTLJ.description: Child Pose Arms on Side is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes.

ex_JWIPAM.name: Child Pose Elbows on Block
instructions: Begin in a tall kneeling position with two yoga blocks placed in front of you. Rest both elbows on each block and bring your hands together behind your head.
Sit your hips back toward your heels as you lower your chest toward the floor.
Allow your elbows to remain on the block while gently sinking your chest to deepen the stretch through your shoulders and upper back.
Hold the stretch, then slowly return to the starting position with control.
tips: Keep your elbows supported on the block throughout the stretch.
Keep your hips moving toward your heels as you lower your chest.
Avoid rounding your lower back excessively.
Inhale before lowering and exhale as you deepen the stretch.
ex_JWIPAM.description: Child Pose Elbows on Block is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Upper Back, Lower Back.

ex_YYVHL2.name: Crescent Moon Pose
instructions: Begin in a lunge position with one foot forward and your back knee resting on the floor. Bend your back knee and reach behind you to grasp your back foot with both hands.
Gently draw your back heel toward your glutes while keeping your chest lifted and your hips facing forward.
Hold the stretch until you feel a comfortable stretch along the front of your back thigh and hip.
Release your foot with control, return to the starting position, and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Keep your front knee directly above your ankle.
Engage your core to help maintain balance and alignment.
Keep your chest lifted and avoid leaning excessively forward.
Inhale before deepening the stretch and exhale as you gently pull your foot closer.
ex_YYVHL2.description: Crescent Moon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Glutes, Core.

ex_VM6UGM.name: Criss Cross Bow Tie Pose
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended. Cross one arm over the other, palms facing down.
Walk your hands out in opposite directions as far as possible, dipping your head and chest toward the floor.
Relax your shoulders and hold the position until you feel a comfortable stretch across the back of your shoulder and upper back.
Release the stretch slowly and repeat with the opposite arm crossed underneath.
tips: Stretch only until you feel a gentle pull across the shoulder and upper back.
Keep both shoulders relaxed throughout the stretch.
Avoid lifting your torso or twisting your hips.
Inhale slowly and exhale as you relax into the position.
ex_VM6UGM.description: Criss Cross Bow Tie Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Middle Back, Rotator Cuff.

ex_OKDVFP.name: Crow Pose
instructions: Begin in a deep squat with your feet slightly wider than hip width apart. Place both hands flat on the floor shoulder width apart in front of you.
Lean your body forward and position the insides of your knees against the outsides of your elbows.
Shift your weight onto your hands and lift both feet off the floor, balancing with your knees supported slightly above your elbows.
Hold the position briefly, then slowly lower your feet back to the floor and return to the starting position.
tips: Spread your fingers wide to create a stable base of support.
Keep your gaze slightly forward rather than directly at the floor to help maintain balance.
Shift your weight forward gradually until your feet lift naturally.
Inhale before shifting your weight forward and exhale as you lift your feet from the floor.
ex_OKDVFP.description: Crow Pose is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Chest, Hip Flexors.

ex_M67SXQ.name: Double Pigeon Pose
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Bend your right knee and position your shin horizontally in front of you. Lift the other leg and stack your top shin over the bottom shin so both shins are nearly parallel.
Sit upright with a long spine and gently rest your forearms on your top shin while relaxing your hips. Lean into your forearms applying slight pressure on the top leg.
Hold the stretch, then uncross your legs with control and repeat with the opposite leg on top.
tips: Relax your hips and allow your knees to lower naturally without forcing them.
If one hip lifts off the floor, reduce the depth of the position until both hips are evenly supported.
Stack your shins as evenly as your flexibility allows.
Inhale as you lengthen your spine and exhale as you relax deeper into the stretch.
ex_M67SXQ.description: Double Pigeon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hip Flexors.

ex_NFJLSA.name: Downward Dog Toe to Heel
instructions: Stand upright with your feet at shoulder width apart and raise both arms overhead. Bend forward, place your hands on the floor, in front of your feet with a slight bend in your knees.
Walk your feet backward until your body forms an inverted V shape. Keep your hands and feet at shoulder width apart, and lift your hips upward.
Press your left heel into the floor as you bend the right knee, placing your foot in a position where the toes of your right foot align with heel of your left leg.
Hold for a few seconds, then walk your feet back to the starting position. Stand up and alternate sides.
tips: Press firmly through your palms and spread your fingers for stability.
Keep your neck relaxed and your gaze directed toward your feet or between your legs.
Lift your hips upward to lengthen your spine throughout the movement.
Inhale as you prepare and exhale each time you press a heel toward the floor.
ex_NFJLSA.description: Downward Dog Toe to Heel is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core, Upper Back.

ex_F5AEPK.name: Downward Dog With Fingers Facing Feet
instructions: Stand upright with your feet at shoulder width apart and raise both arms overhead. Bend forward, place your hands on the floor, with your fingers pointing at your feet and a slight bend in your knees.
Walk your feet backward until your body forms an inverted V shape. Keep your hands and feet planted on the floor, lifting your hips upward.
Straighten your arms and legs, keeping a slight bend in each joint as you lift your hips toward the ceiling and gently press your chest toward your thighs.
Hold the stretch, then walk your feet back toward your hands and slowly return to a standing position.
tips: Spread your fingers and press evenly through your palms to support your wrists.
Reduce the amount of hand rotation if you feel discomfort in your wrists.
Keep your head relaxed between your arms.
Inhale as you move into the stretch and exhale as you deepen it.
ex_F5AEPK.description: Downward Dog With Fingers Facing Feet is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Upper Back, Hamstrings.

ex_VUOK7M.name: Eagle Arms Chin Into Chest
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Raise both arms outward to shoulder height, then bring them forward in front of your chest.
Cross one upper arm over the other at the elbows, bend both elbows, and wrap your forearms around each other until the back of your hands press together.
Lift your elbows in front of your face, gently tuck your chin toward your chest, and allow your upper back to round slightly until you feel a stretch across your shoulders, upper back, and neck.
Hold the position briefly, then lift your head, unwrap your arms, and return them to your sides. Repeat with the opposite arm crossed on top.
tips: Wrap your forearms only as far as your shoulder mobility comfortably allows.
Press the backs of your arms together if your hands cannot meet.
Keep your elbows lifted while gently drawing your shoulder blades apart.
Inhale as you prepare and exhale as you tuck your chin and deepen the stretch.
ex_VUOK7M.description: Eagle Arms Chin Into Chest is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Neck, Middle Back.

ex_3VKI6C.name: Easy Pose Neck Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart, your shoulders relaxed, and your arms resting by your sides.
Raise one arm over your head and place your hand gently above the opposite ear
Slowly draw your head toward the raised-arm side, bringing your ear toward your shoulder while keeping your opposite shoulder lowered and your torso upright.
Hold the stretch, then release your head gradually and lower your arm before repeating on the opposite side.
tips: Draw your head gently toward your shoulder instead of pulling forcefully.
Keep your spine tall and avoid rounding your upper back.
Stop if you feel pinching, dizziness, or discomfort in your neck.
Inhale before tilting your head and exhale as you relax into the stretch.
ex_3VKI6C.description: Easy Pose Neck Stretch is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the levator scapulae (neck). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

ex_GIFMS7.name: Easy Seated Twist Pose
instructions: Sit upright with your legs crossed, placing your shins parallel to each other. Rest both hands on your leg on top and lengthen your spine.
Rotate your torso to one side, placing the back of your opposite forearm above your knee, and position your other hand on the floor behind your hips for support.
Keep your hips grounded as you rotate your chest and shoulders toward your rear hand, then gently turn your head to look over the same shoulder.
Hold the stretch, return your torso and head to the center with control, then reverse your hand placement and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Position your rear hand close to your body to support an upright posture.
Rotate through your torso without forcing the movement with your arms.
Use the hand on your opposite knee only as a gentle guide.
Inhale as you lengthen your spine and exhale as you rotate deeper into the stretch.
ex_GIFMS7.description: Easy Seated Twist Pose is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Lower Back, Upper Back.

ex_ZLP2B6.name: Extended Side Angle Pose With Block
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and place a yoga block vertically in front of your right toes. Step your left foot back and out to the side into a wide stance, turning your foot outward. Keep your left leg extended, and bend your right knee.
Lean your torso toward your right thigh and place your right hand on top of the block, using it for light support while keeping both feet firmly planted.
Rotate your chest open, raising your left arm toward the ceiling, then bend your elbow and reach your forearm over your head to lengthen the side of your torso.

Hold the position, then raise your left arm toward the ceiling, lift your torso upright, straighten your right leg, and step your left foot forward. Repeat on the opposite side with the block positioned in front of your left toes.
tips: Place only light pressure through your right hand instead of leaning heavily on the block.
Keep both feet firmly planted and maintain a stable, wide stance.
Keep your right knee aligned with your right toes without allowing it to collapse inward.
Inhale as you rotate your chest open and exhale as you reach your arm over your head.
ex_ZLP2B6.description: Extended Side Angle Pose With Block is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Quadriceps, Glutes.

ex_SYZFLS.name: Extended Side Angle Pose
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart, then step one foot back and out to the side into a wide stance. Turn your back foot outward and keep your back leg extended, while bending the knee of your front leg.
Lean your torso toward your front thigh and place your same-side hand on the floor inside your front foot, keeping both feet firmly planted.
Rotate your chest open, raise your opposite arm toward the ceiling, then bend your elbow and reach your forearm over your head to lengthen the side of your torso.
Hold the position, then straighten your upper arm, lift your torso, straighten your front leg, and step back to the starting position before repeating on the opposite side.
tips: Use your lower hand lightly for balance instead of placing all your weight through it.
Rotate your chest upward and avoid allowing your upper shoulder to roll forward.
Keep your hips stable as you lengthen your upper arm over your head.
Inhale as you open your chest and exhale as you deepen the side stretch.
ex_SYZFLS.description: Extended Side Angle Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes, Hamstrings.

ex_OUGPB6.name: Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up
instructions: Begin in a tall kneeling position. Extend your left leg straight out to the side for support and place your right hand on the floor directly under your shoulder.
Keep your right knee under your hip and your extended leg straight as you lean to the side.
Rotate your chest upward and extend your left arm over your head. Turn your head and look up toward ceiling.
Hold the stretch, then lower your left arm and return upright. Repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Press evenly through your right palm for support.
Rotate your chest upward without allowing your hips to roll backward.
Look upward only as far as your neck remains comfortable.
Inhale while upright and exhale as you lean to the side.
ex_OUGPB6.description: Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Middle Back, Shoulders, Core.

ex_GYRXU6.name: Gate Pose Variation Arm Extended on Side
instructions: Begin in a tall kneeling position, then extend your left leg straight out to the side for support.
Lean to your right and place your right hand on the floor directly under your shoulder, with your arm extended.
Extend your left arm over your head while keeping your chest and gaze facing forward.
Hold the stretch, then return upright and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward without rotating upward.
Keep your supporting knee directly below your hip.
Keep your hips stable as you bend to the side.
Inhale while upright, then exhale as you lean and extend your arm over your head.
ex_GYRXU6.description: Gate Pose Variation Arm Extended on Side is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Middle Back, Shoulders, Core.

ex_ICPWUJ.name: Half Lotus
instructions: Sit upright on the floor with both legs extended in front of you.
Bend your left knee and place your left ankle above your right knee so your shins are perpendicular to each other.
Support your left foot with your right hand and place your left hand on your left knee.
Gently press your left knee downward while keeping your torso upright, then release and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Place your ankle just above your knee, not directly on the kneecap.
Press the knee of your working leg downward gently without forcing it.
Keep your spine tall and your shoulders relaxed.
Inhale while sitting upright and exhale as you gently press your knee downward.
ex_ICPWUJ.description: Half Lotus is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Adductors.

ex_GOJC2I.name: Half Monkey Pose
instructions: Begin in a tall kneeling position, then extend one leg forward with your heel on the floor and your toes pointing upward.
Keep your hips stable above your kneeling knee as you straighten your front leg, keeping your heel on the floor.
Lean forward over your straight leg and place both hands on the floor beside your foot.
Hold the stretch. Return to the starting position, then repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Point your front toes upward to deepen the calf and hamstring stretch.
Position your rear knee comfortably beneath your hip.
Use your hands lightly for support without placing excessive weight through them.
Inhale while you are in the upright position and exhale as you lean forward.
ex_GOJC2I.description: Half Monkey Pose is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Glutes, Lower Back.

ex_MEWXLB.name: Happy Baby
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees toward your chest, and hold the outside of each foot with your hands.
Open your knees wider than your torso and raise your feet so the soles face upward.
Gently pull your feet downward while keeping your head, shoulders, and lower back on the floor.
Hold the stretch, then release your feet and return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your ankles positioned above your knees.
Draw your knees toward the sides of your torso.
Use a comfortable range without forcing your hips or knees.
Inhale as you prepare and exhale as you deepen the stretch.
ex_MEWXLB.description: Happy Baby is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Lower Back.

ex_OLN2XH.name: Lord of the Dance
instructions: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot or ankle behind you.
Reach your free arm forward.
Kick your foot back into your hand as you tilt your torso forward.
Hold the balance, then switch sides.
tips: Focus your eyes on one point for balance.
Keep the standing knee soft.
ex_OLN2XH.description: Lord of the Dance is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Shoulders, Core.

ex_M42AAH.name: Monkey Pose
instructions: From a low lunge, slowly slide your front heel forward and your back knee back.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor or on blocks.
Lower your hips toward the floor in a split, as far as is comfortable.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Use blocks under your hands and hips.
Never force the split.
ex_M42AAH.description: Monkey Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes.

ex_R7LSHH.name: One Arm Cow Face Pose - Easy
instructions: Sit or stand tall.
Reach one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your back.
With your other hand, gently press the bent elbow back.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your head upright.
Use a strap if needed.
ex_R7LSHH.description: One Arm Cow Face Pose - Easy is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lats.

ex_77YDUM.name: Pigeon Glutes Stretch
instructions: From a plank or all fours, bring one knee forward behind your wrist with the shin angled across.
Extend the other leg straight back.
Lower your hips toward the floor and fold forward over your front leg.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Put a cushion under your hip if it doesn't reach the floor.
Keep your hips level.
ex_77YDUM.description: Pigeon Glutes Stretch is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_TPV6XV.name: Pigeon Pose
instructions: From all fours, bring one knee forward toward your wrist with the shin angled across your body.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Lower your hips and keep your chest lifted.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Square your hips toward the front.
Use a block under your hip if needed.
ex_TPV6XV.description: Pigeon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

ex_A77M52.name: Puppy Pose
instructions: Start on all fours.
Walk your hands forward, keeping your hips over your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Rest your forehead down and hold, breathing slowly.
tips: Keep your arms active.
Let your chest melt toward the floor.
ex_A77M52.description: Puppy Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Chest.

ex_EHY5PZ.name: Pyramid Pose - Parsvottanasana
instructions: Stand with one foot forward and the other back, feet about 3 feet apart and the back foot turned out slightly.
Square your hips toward the front.
Hinge forward over your front leg with a long spine.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Bend your front knee slightly if needed.
Lead with your chest.
ex_EHY5PZ.description: Pyramid Pose - Parsvottanasana is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Lower Back.

ex_R32JPK.name: Pyramid Pose Blocks
instructions: Stand in a split stance with yoga blocks on either side of your front foot.
Square your hips forward.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the blocks.
Hold with a long spine, then switch sides.
tips: Raise the blocks if your back rounds.
Keep both legs active.
ex_R32JPK.description: Pyramid Pose Blocks is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Lower Back.

ex_EX3WFC.name: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the ball of your front foot raised on a block.
Square your hips forward.
Hinge forward over the front leg.
Hold, feeling the stretch in your calf and hamstring, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your heel down on the floor.
Go only as far as is comfortable.
ex_EX3WFC.description: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

ex_J4L6GY.name: Pyramid Prayer
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the back foot turned out slightly.
Join your palms behind your back in a reverse prayer, or hold your elbows.
Hinge forward over the front leg with a long spine.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Hold your elbows if reverse prayer is too intense.
Keep your chest open.
ex_J4L6GY.description: Pyramid Prayer is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.

ex_3SKM46.name: Reclining Pigeon Pose
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh.
Pull the lower leg toward your chest by holding behind the thigh.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Flex the foot of the crossed leg to protect the knee.
ex_3SKM46.description: Reclining Pigeon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_IIVM6N.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge Abduction
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a loop resistance band just above your knees. Keep your hands extended by your sides with hands firm on the floor.
Engage your core and glutes, and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
While holding the bridge position, press your knees outward against the resistance band to stretch them as far as possible.
Slowly bring your knees back together, then lower your hips back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back; keep a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Focus on engaging your glutes and hip abductors throughout the movement.
Exhale as you lift your hips and press your knees outward, and inhale as you bring your knees back together and lower your hips .
ex_IIVM6N.description: Resistance Band Glute Bridge Abduction is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Abductors, Core, Hamstrings.

ex_6XBDDM.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a loop resistance band just above your knees. Keep your hands extended by your sides with hands firm on the floor.
Engage your core and glutes, and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Hold the bridge position for a moment, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back; keep a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Focus on engaging your glutes throughout the movement.
Exhale as you lift your hips and press your knees outward, and inhale as you bring your knees back together and lower your hips .
ex_6XBDDM.description: Resistance Band Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Hamstrings, Abductors.

ex_ONITG4.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge (Version 2)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a loop resistance band just above your knees. Bring your hands close to your chest and interlock your fingers.
Engage your core and glutes, and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Hold the bridge position for a moment, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back; keep a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Focus on engaging your glutes throughout the movement.
Exhale as you lift your hips and press your knees outward, and inhale as you bring your knees back together and lower your hips .
ex_ONITG4.description: Resistance Band Glute Bridge (Version 2) is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Hamstrings, Abductors.

ex_TO4FGS.name: Resistance Band Upper Body Dead Bug
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle, knees right above your hips. Attach two loop resistance bands at a low point, extending behind you.
Hold the end of each band in each hand, keeping your arms extended straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower your right leg towards the floor while keeping your left leg and arms in the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lower your leg and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor to avoid strain.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement.
ex_TO4FGS.description: Resistance Band Upper Body Dead Bug is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_ZT6H6V.name: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs
instructions: Sit and stack one knee on top of the other, with your feet beside your hips.
Sit evenly on both sit bones.
Fold forward over your knees, or stay upright.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch the top leg.
tips: Sit on a cushion if your hips are tight.
Don't force your knees together.
ex_ZT6H6V.description: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

ex_P5P7JF.name: Reverse Prayer
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Bring your hands behind your back and join your palms with your fingers pointing up.
Press your palms together and open your chest.
Hold, breathing slowly.
tips: Hold opposite elbows as an easier version.
Keep your shoulders back.
ex_P5P7JF.description: Reverse Prayer is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

ex_BFILNN.name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner
instructions: Step into a lunge and lower your back knee to the floor.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and place your opposite elbow outside your front knee.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep the back knee down for stability.
Twist gradually with each breath.
ex_BFILNN.description: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

ex_X5UPGN.name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands
instructions: Step into a lunge with your front knee over your ankle.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your opposite elbow outside your front knee.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Lengthen your spine before you twist.
Lower your back knee to make it easier.
ex_X5UPGN.description: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hip Flexors.

ex_NADO4M.name: Runners Lunge
instructions: From standing, step one foot far back into a lunge.
Place your hands on the floor beside your front foot.
Lower your hips and extend your back leg.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Lower your back knee to rest.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
ex_NADO4M.description: Runners Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Glutes.

ex_WJBNGK.name: Scorpion Twist Pose
instructions: Lie face down with your arms stretched out to the sides.
Bend one knee.
Lift and rotate that leg across your body toward the opposite hand.
Return and switch sides.
tips: Keep both shoulders on the floor.
Move slowly.
ex_WJBNGK.description: Scorpion Twist Pose is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Glutes.

ex_2VHYH5.name: Side Lying Parsva Savasana Variation
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees slightly bent.
Rest your head on your arm or a cushion.
Let your whole body relax.
Breathe slowly and stay for the set time.
tips: Place a cushion between your knees.
Focus on your breathing.
ex_2VHYH5.description: Side Lying Parsva Savasana Variation is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category.

ex_4VJDO3.name: Wild Thing Pose
instructions: From a side plank, step your top foot back behind you with the knee bent.
Lift your hips.
Reach your top arm overhead and open your chest toward the ceiling.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep pressing the floor away with your supporting hand.
Move slowly into the backbend.
ex_4VJDO3.description: Wild Thing Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Glutes, Core.

ex_5ZUXOD.name: Yoga Flow Sequences Sun Salutations
instructions: Stand tall, raise your arms overhead, then fold forward.
Step back into a plank and lower to the floor.
Lift into a cobra or upward dog, then push back into downward dog.
Step forward, rise up with your arms overhead and repeat the flow.
tips: Link each movement with one breath.
Move at a pace that keeps your breathing steady.
ex_5ZUXOD.description: Yoga Flow Sequences Sun Salutations is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hamstrings, Core.
